name: Hand Axe
description: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool. Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.
obtain: Bought from the Nomadic Merchant located in Mistwood south of the Minor Erdtree for 600 runes.
lore: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool.
Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.

name: Jawbone Axe
description: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal. This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.
obtain: It has a 2% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors who wield it.
lore: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal.
This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.

name: Forked Hatchet
description: Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.
obtain: Dropped by hatchet-wielding Fanged Imp enemies (2% chance).
lore: Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps.
The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

name: Iron Cleaver
description: Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten.  Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.
obtain: 2% chance to drop from regular Misbegottens.
lore: Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten.
Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.

name: Battle Axe
description: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.
obtain:
Starting melee armament for the Hero origin.
Sold by Twin Maiden Husks for 800 Runes.
lore: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon.
Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.

name: Ripple Blade
description: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.
obtain: Sold by Pidia, Carian Servant for  3500 runes, or alternatively by the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Pidia's Bell Bearing.
lore: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species.
Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.

name: Icerind Hatchet
description: A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north. Known as "freezing fog," the blade is thought to be a dragon's scale. Inflicts a powerful frost effect.
obtain: Found inside a chest near the  Temple Quarter grace, located southwest of the Academy of Raya Lucaria in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north.
Known as "freezing fog," the blade is thought to be a dragon's scale. Inflicts a powerful frost effect.

name: Sacrificial Axe
description: Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity. The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.
obtain: Received upon defeating the Deathbird located in the Weeping Peninsula. It will appear over the cliffs by the wall north-northeast of Castle Morne at night. Should the Golem Archer in the area still be alive, its arrows may help defeat the Deathbird.
lore: Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity.
The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.

name: Celebrant's Cleaver
description: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.
obtain:
Location: Altus Plateau
Celebrant's Cleaver has a 0.5% random chance to drop from Dominula Dancers that wield it in Dominula, Windmill Village or East Windmill Pasture.
lore: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.
Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

name: Rosus' Axe
description: Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Lands Between, is depicted on this ritual axe. The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need i of a guiding hand.
obtain: Found inside Black Knife Catacombs, located to the northeast in Liurnia of the Lakes. It requires one Stonesword Key to access.
lore: Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Lands Between, is depicted on this ritual axe.
The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need of a guiding hand.
Unique Skill: Rosus's Summons
Raise the axe aloft to summon those lost in death. Three skeletons will appear at a distance and attack in tandem before vanishing.

name: Highland Axe
description: Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands.  Brave combatants begin battle by crying out their names. Roars are enhanced by this weapon.
obtain:
Location: Stormveil Castle
The Highland Axe is found directly beneath a large painting of Elden Lord Godfrey and Serosh at Stormveil Castle.
This area contains a Grafted Scion and may be reached by from the  Rampart Tower Site of Grace by descending the nearby elevator.
lore: Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands.
Brave combatants begin battle by crying out their names. Roars are enhanced by this weapon.

name: Warped Axe
description: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance. Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.
obtain: 4% chance to drop from axe-wielding Omens.
lore: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance.
Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.

name: Stormhawk Axe
description: Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, wioth its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth. Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.
obtain:
One inside Castle Sol, on a rooftop not far from where you find the Sorcerer Painting.
One inside Leyndell, Royal Capital, in the court outside of the Fortified Manor where Abductor Virgin enemies are roaming.
Two are dropped by Nepheli Loux if she is killed in the Village of the Albinaurics.
ru:Секира штормовых ястребов
lore: Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, with its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth.
Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.
Unique Skill : Thunderstorm

Imbue the armament's wing-blade with lightning and swing it around to create a tempestuous lightning storm. Follow up with an additional imput to perform up to two spinning attacks. The lightning will stay on the blade for a while.

name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
description: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
obtain: Received upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred right before the Grand Lift of Rold located in the Forbidden Lands.
lore: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.
Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

name: Hand Ballista
description: An unconventional ballistic device modeled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts.  Perfect for reckless acts such as storming a castle on facing an entire army alone.
obtain: Found inside a chest at the top of the Forest Lookout Tower on the Weeping Peninsula, immediately west of the Bridge of Sacrifice from Limgrave.
lore: An unconventional ballistic device modelled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts.
Perfect for reckless acts such as storming a castle or facing an entire army alone.

name: Jar Cannon
description: Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload.  Experimental firearm brought to the assault on Volcano Manor, where it was discovered that no one knew how to use it.
obtain: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot inside Volcano Cave located on Mt. Gelmir.
lore: Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload.
Experimental firearm brought to the assault on Volcano Manor, where it was discovered that no one knew how to use it.

name: Longbow
description: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.
obtain:
Part of Samurai origin's starting equipment.
Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,200 Runes.
2% chance to be dropped by Skeletons wielding the longbow.
lore: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage.
To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

name: Albinauric Bow
description: Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers. This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.
obtain: 4% chance to drop from Albinauric Archers in the Consecrated Snowfield.
lore: Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers.
This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.

name: Erdtree Bow
description: Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.
obtain: Found inside a chest that can be accessed by going onto the rooftops near the  Erdtree Sanctuary grace and then to the upper floors, located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
lore: Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow.
Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

name: Horn Bow
description: Longbow made from animal horn. Wielded by the master hunters of the ancestral followers.  Imbues arrows fired with magic damage. Reveals its true worth when used magic-infused arrows.
obtain:
Siofra River
Found on a corpse under the stairwell leading up to the lower Hallowhorn Grounds.
lore: Longbow made from animal horn. Wielded by master hunters of the ancestral followers.
Imbues arrows fired with magic damage. Reveals its true worth when used with magic-infused arrows.

name: Serpent Bow
description: Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows. Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.
obtain: Found on a corpse partially submerged in a pool of Scarlet Rot within the Abandoned Cave in Caelid.
lore: Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows.
Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.

name: Pulley Bow
description: Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and strings. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order Fundamentalism.  Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.
obtain:
Mt. Gelmir
Found on a corpse at the top of a siege tower to the west of the  First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.
lore: Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and strings. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understand to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism.
Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.

name: Black Bow
description: Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master. The blade-like body of the bow is light and cuts through the air. Though a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a shortbow.
obtain: Found on a corpse on the rooftops of the lower district of Leyndell, Royal Capital.
lore: Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master.
The blade-like body of the bow is light and cuts through the air. Though a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a shortbow.

name: Bloodhound Claws
description: Large curved claws used by Bloodhound Knights. The curve allows the weapon to slip through an enemy's guard.
obtain: Received after defeating the Bloodhound Knight inside the secret tunnels in Volcano Manor that connect the welcoming chambers to the  Prison Town Church.
lore: Large curved claws used by Bloodhound Knights.
The curve allows the weapon to slip through an enemy's guard.

name: Venomous Fang
description: One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.
obtain: Found on a corpse on top of a ledge reached by climbing the remains of destroyed Abductor Virgins inside the Abandoned Cave, located in Caelid.
lore: One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.

name: Hookclaws
description: Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark. Lacerations cause blood loss with great effect.  Claw weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.
obtain: Found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, near the  Stormveil Cliffside grace, in the far corner of the lowest room in the western wall area.
lore: Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark. Lacerations cause blood loss with great effect.
Claw weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

name: Raptor Talons
description: Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades, wielded by the assassins of Ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds. Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.
obtain: Found inside Sage's Cave, located in Altus Plateau. They can be found inside a chest just beyond a room containing four skeletons, hidden behind an illusionary wall.
lore: Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades. Wielded by the assassins of ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds.
Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.

name: Watchdog's Greatsword
description: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.
obtain:
Dropped from the Erdtree Burial Watchdog enemies that wield it.
The simplest grinding spot is in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. A Watchdog shade is found in the first big open room with a circle of Rosus's light. It staggers when led into the light, making for easy damage at the start of combat. If it is approached from behind by dropping down from the high windows, the two imp shades in the room can be defeated before approaching the Watchdog.
lore: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs.
Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.

name: Greatsword
description: A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight. Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.
obtain: Looted from the black carriage directly northwest of Caelem Ruins in Caelid.
lore: A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight.
Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.
loreNotes: This weapon's guard rating was significantly increased with patch 1.04, from 67/50/50/50/50/38 to 84/50/50/50/50/56.
The Greatsword is a reminiscent of the weapon Dragon Slayer that Guts wields in Berserk.

name: Troll's Golden Sword
description: Sword given to the giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago. Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape—such that the gold plating had flaked away.
obtain:
Location: Altus Plateau
Immediately southeast of the  Erdtree-Gazing Hill grace, Altus Plateau, in a black carriage within an enemy encampment.
lore: Sword given to the lesser giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago.
Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape—such that the gold plating had flaked away.

name: Maliketh's Black Blade
description: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.
obtain:
The blade is acquired by using the Remembrance of the Black Blade, gained by defeating Maliketh, The Black Blade in Crumbling Farum Azula near the end of the game, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
lore: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory.
After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.
Unique Skill: Destined Death

Set free the remnants of Destined Death, plunging the greatsword into the ground to summon a myriad of blades. In addition to dealing immediate damage, this attack reduces the enemy's maximum HP and continues to wear down HP for a short time.
loreNotes: This weapon's guard rating was significantly increased in patch 1.04, from 51/36/36/36/49/38 to 68/36/36/36/49/55. It is still on the lower end when it comes to colossal sword guard ratings.
Patch 1.09 increase this weapon's scaling values.

name: Zweihander
description: Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so. The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.
obtain: Isolated Merchant in his shack in the Weeping Peninsula region (x1)
lore: Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so.
The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.
loreNotes: Zweihänder is a real German weapon that translates to "two-hander."

name: Royal Greatsword
description: Greatsword decorated in royal Carian Style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf. In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof. the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment oath was sworn.
obtain: Obtained from Blaidd, along with his armor set (except the Black Wolf Mask), when encountered at Ranni's Rise after Ranni the Witch's storyline has been completed. Killing him prior to this will award no items.
lore: Greatsword decorated in royal Carian Style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf.
In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof. the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment oath was sworn.
Unique Skill: Wolf's Assault
Infuse the greatsword with frost, then perform a forward somersault to plunge it into the ground. Then, pull it out to release a cold blast.
loreNotes: This weapon's guard ratings were significantly increased with patch 1.04, from 55/63/44/44/44/42 to 71/63/44/44/44/52.
Patch 1.04 increased the cast speed and decreased recovery time for the skill.
Patch 1.07 increased the poise when casting the skill.
Patch 1.09 increased the scaling values of the weapon.

name: Godslayer's Greatsword
description: Sacred sword of the Dusk-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh. The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.
obtain:
Location: Divine Tower of Caelid
The Godslayer's Greatsword is looted at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid, located in central Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. It is stored within a treasure chest guarded by the Godskin Apostle boss.
lore: Sacred sword of the Gloam-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh.
The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.
Unique Skill: The Queen's Black Flame
Set the blade ablaze with the god-slaying black flame before delivering a sweeping slash. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack. The black flames will continue to wear down HP for a while.
loreNotes: Update 1.04 increased the guarding effectiveness for each damage affinity from 49/38/49/38/38/36 to 63/38/49/38/38/45.

name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
description: The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret.  One of the legendary armaments.  A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.
obtain:
Location: Castle Morne
The Grafted Blade Greatsword is obtained upon defeating the Leonine Misbegotten at the Morne Moangrave behind Castle Morne at the southern tip of the Weeping Peninsula.
lore: The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret. One of the legendary armaments.
A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.
Unique Skill: Oath of Vengeance
Swear an oath upon the greatsword to avenge the clan, temporarily raising all attributes for a certain duration. While the oath's effects are active, poise will also be increased.
loreNotes: This weapon received several buffs in patch 1.04. Its base damage (+0) was increased from 157 to 162 and its guard rating increaed from 64/48/48/48/48/43 to 80/48/48/48/48/53.
This is one of the earliest available Colossal Swords or Weapons and most likely the second acquired after the Zweihander, also found on the Weeping Peninsula.

The Chinese and Korean release of the game preserve a very different earlier draft of this item description, roughly translating to "A special greatsword created by joining together the swords of warriors who once served Godfrey. It is imbued with the power of the Rune of Grafting."

name: Ruins Greatsword
description: Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon. One of the legendary armaments. The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbords its destructive power.
obtain:
Obtained upon defeating the optional Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo boss at the Redmane Castle plaza.
Note that this fight is only available whenever the Radahn festival isn't active. If it's currently active, it can be deactivated by defeating Starscourge Radahn and talking to Jerren once more in the chapel just before the lift down to Radahn and then reloading the area, preferably by teleporting to the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace.
lore: Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon. One of the legendary armaments.
The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbors its destructive power.
Unique Skill: Wave of Destruction
Raise the sword up high, then strike it against the ground to fire off a wave of gravitational force.
loreNotes: The ruin that the rubble used to make this sword originated from was most likely Crumbling Farum Azula, giving its dilapidated state and nearby location.

While the weapon resembles the Fume Ultra Greatsword from Dark Souls II and Dark Souls III, it even more so resembles the King's Ultra Greatsword from Dark Souls 2, especially because it resembles a statue wielded on a hilt.
This weapon's guard rating was increased in patch 1.04, from 65/56/50/50/50/45 to 82/56/50/50/50/56.

name: Starscourge Greatsword
description: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in this youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest up these blades.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge, dropped by Starscourge Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
lore: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.
Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in his youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest upon these blades.
Unique Skill: Starcaller Cry
Bring the two swords together and roar into the skies, pulling in enemies with a gravitational wave. Follow up with an additional input to slam down with gravity-infused swords.
loreNotes: This weapon's guard ratings were significantly increased with patch 1.04, from 49/47/34/34/34/42 to 65/47/34/34/34/52.
Patch 1.09 increased the scaling values as well as the speed of guard counters.

name: Troll Knight's Sword
description: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.
obtain: Dropped by the sword-wielding Troll Knight in Caria Manor.
lore: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria.
Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.
loreNotes: This weapon's guard ratings were significantly increased with patch 1.04, from 55/55/43/43/43/40 to 70/55/43/43/43/50.

name: Watchdog's Staff
description: Large stone staff embedded with glintstone. Wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs who protect catacombs. The Watchdogs, battered and broken over their lengthy tenure, rule the catacombs and are even said to command the imps. Unique Skill: Sorcery of the Crozier Channel magic into the glintstone to activate an ancient sorcery, producing floating magic projectiles that chase enemies automatically.
obtain: Found on a corpse behind an illusory wall under a stairwell, inside Road's End Catacombs, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Large stone staff embedded with glintstone. Wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs who protect catacombs.
The Watchdogs, battered and broken over their lengthy tenure, rule the catacombs and are even said to command the imps.
Unique Skill: Sorcery of the Crozier
Channel magic into the glintstone to activate an ancient sorcery, producing floating magic projectiles that chase enemies automatically.

name: Envoy's Greathorn
description: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.
obtain: 2% chance to drop from Giant Oracle Envoys found in the branches of Miquella's Haligtree.
lore: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.
Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.
Unique Skill: Great Oracular Bubble
Blow on the horn to release a massive magic bubble. The bubble floats gently through the air towards its target.

name: Great Club
description: An enormous club of hardwood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force. While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.
obtain: Received upon defeating Stonedigger Troll located inside the Old Altus Tunnel, in Altus Plateau. The tunnel requires two Stonesword Keys to access.
lore: An enormous club of hard wood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force.
While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.
loreNotes: In patch 1.09, the Great Club received holy damage and faith scaling, perhaps to reflect its nature as a branch of the Erdtree.

name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
description: Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship.  The hammer's head is unusually substantial, and strong attacks' will fling foes into the air.
obtain: Guaranteed to be dropped by the Fire Prelate in the courtyard of Fort Laiedd, west of the  Seethewater Terminus Site of Grace on Mt. Gelmir, which is reached at the end of the gorge starting northwest of Wyndham Ruins.
lore: Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship.
The hammer's head is unusually substansial, and strong attacks will fling foes into the air.

name: Duelist Greataxe
description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.
obtain:
4% chance to drop from the Grave Warden Duelists that wield it outside the Royal Colosseum near the West Capital Rampart grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
The Duelists cannot be found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. The greataxe can therefore not be acquired after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
lore: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.

name: Axe Of Godfrey
description: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux, dropped by Hoarah Loux, Warrior, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
lore: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March.
This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.
Unique Skill: Regal Roar
Let loose a mighty war cry, raising attack power, while sending out a shockwave that cannot be guarded against by stomping the ground. While active, strong attack becomes a lunging slash.

name: Dragon Greatclaw
description: Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree. The claw is enwreathed with lightning,and tears through the dragons' feeble descendants with ease.
obtain: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss guarding the entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital in the Capital Outskirts.
lore: Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree.
The claw is enwreathed with lightning, and tears through the dragons' feeble descendants with ease.

name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw
description: Part of a Falling star Beast's jaw, hard and shining black, fashioned into a weapon.  With its sharp point, this colossal weapon can skewer foes.
obtain: Acquired by defeating the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast boss in a large crater on a peak on Mt. Gelmir, south of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.
lore: Part of a Fallingstar Beast's jaw, hard and shining black, fashioned into a weapon.
With its sharp point, this colossal weapon can skewer foes.
Unique Skill: Gravity Bolt
Imbue the jaw of the fallingstar beast with gravitational lightning sending a bolt crashing down a short distance away. Can be fired in rapid succession.
loreNotes: Patch 1.08 decreased poise damage dealt by this weapon (Colossal Weapons more specifically) and greatly decreased the Stance damage dealt by the skill, from 33 (on par with a dual-wielded jump attack of this weapon) to 7 (less than half of that of a light attack).
Patch 1.09 increased this weapon's scaling values.

name: Staff Of The Avatar
description: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees. The avatars, emerging in the wake of the Elden Ring's shattering, were determined to protect the withering Erdtree's offspring.
obtain: Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar south of the Great Waterfall Crest grace located in Deeproot Depths.
lore: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.
The avatars, emerging in the wake of the Elden Ring's shattering, were determined to protect the withering Erdtree's offspring.
Unique Skill: Erdtree Slam
Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends golden shockwaves in all directions.

name: Ghiza's Wheel
description: Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss. The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins.
obtain: Dropped by the red phantom of Inquisitor Ghiza in the Volcano Manor. He is found upstairs from the  Volcano Manor Site of Grace in the dinner hall.
lore: Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss.
The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins.
Unique Skill: Spinning Wheel
Strike the wheel against the ground to set it spinning at top speed. Hold to keep the wheel spinning. Can be used while walking to push the armament into enemies.

name: Giant-crusher
description: A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants. One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between. After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.
obtain: Found inside a carriage within an encampment south of  Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace, located in Altus Plateau. An Ulcerated Tree Spirit appears upon approaching the camp.
lore: A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants. One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between.
After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.

name: Golem's Halberd
description: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.
obtain: 10% chance to drop from various Guardian Golem enemies that wield it. 5% chance to drop from the wounded Guardian Golems found in Limgrave.
lore: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.

name: Troll's Hammer
description: Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock.  Trolls are descended form the giants, and these were supposedly once used as ceremonial smithing tools. In the distance past, smithing was considered divine.
obtain: Found on a corpse within a shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel, located on Altus Plateau. The tunnel requires two Stonesword Keys to access.
lore: Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock.
Trolls are descended from the giants, and these were supposedly once used as ceremonial smithing tools. In the distant past, smithing was considered divine.
loreNotes: The Troll Hammer is one of the few weapons with innate elemental damage that can be buffed with greases and spells; the other is the Clayman's Harpoon.

name: Rotten Staff
description: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.
obtain: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar patrolling the bridge in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. The Avatar is visible down and to the right immediately after exiting the chamber with the Prayer Room Site of Grace.
lore: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot.
Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.
Unique Skill: Erdtree Slam
Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends golden shockwaves in all directions.

name: Rotten Greataxe
description: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
obtain: Dropped by a Putrid Grave Warden Duelist northwest of Ordina, Liturgical Town, together with the Rotten Duelist Greaves.
lore: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot.
Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

name: Soldier's Crossbow
description: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.
obtain:
4% chance to be dropped by Foot Soldiers that wield it.
2% chance to be dropped by crossbow-wielding Exile Soldiers in Stormveil Castle.
lore: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy.
Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

name: Light Crossbow
description: Ranged weapoon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.
obtain: Purchased for  1500 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant at the  Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region.
lore: Ranged weapon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing.
Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt. Commonly employed in the Shattering.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped from crossbow-wielding Soldiers, such as Godrick Soldiers.
lore: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt.
Commonly employed in the Shattering.

name: Pulley Crossbow
description: Crossbow made with pulleys and power springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism.   One touch fires a volley of bolts. Be warned; large stores of bolts can be quickly spent.
obtain: Looted from a corpse on a wooden shack platform at the Craftsman's Shack in Mt. Gelmir.
lore: Crossbow made with pulleys and power springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism.
One touch fires a volley of bolts. Be warned; large stores of bolts can be quickly spent.

name: Full Moon Crossbow
description: One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftsmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the houses of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria. The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy- infused bolts.
obtain: Found inside a chest at the top of a bell tower, accessed via the rooftops within the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
lore: One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftsmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the houses of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria.
The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy-infused bolts.
loreNotes: Due to a mistranslation, the description claims that the weapon is strengthened when using Golden Bolts rather than Meteor Bolts. The Japanese description uses 魔力 which means magic or spell, and not holy.

name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
description: Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore.  The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.
obtain:
Location: Sealed Tunnel
Defeat the Onyx Lord boss within the crater at the end of the Sealed Tunnel, located in the Capital Outskirts, to obtain the .
lore: Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic.
A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.
Unique Skill: Onyx Lord's Repulsion
Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack sends enemies flying away.
loreNotes: Patch 1.07 increased the skill's poise during casting and the repelling power of the attack.
Patch 1.09 increased the weapon's scaling values.

name: Crepus's Black-key Crossbow
description: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.
obtain: Found inside a chest beyond the first seal room accessed with a Stonesword Key within the Roundtable Hold.
lore: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range.
Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.

name: Arbalest
description: Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt.firing devices. Its limbs are more pliable than metallic ones, allowing bolts fired from this weapon to pierce even forged of steel.
obtain:
Location: Stormveil Castle
Found on a corpse on a castle rampart of Stormveil Castle, along the direct path from the  Stormveil Main Gate to the inner courtyard. It is located beside an Exile Soldier who operates an explosive Ballista.
lore: Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt-firing devices.
Its limbs are more pliable than metallic ones, allowing bolts fired from this weapon to pierce even helms forged of steel.

name: Bloodhound's Fang
description: Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights. A fearsome blade capable of brutal airborne attacks.
obtain: Dropped by Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in Limgrave. Blaidd the Half-Wolf will direct the Tarnished here as part of his questline, and will be available for summoning in the Evergaol before awakening Darriwil after doing so.
lore: Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights.
A fearsome blade capable of brutal airborne attacks.
Unique Skill: Bloodhound's Finesse

Slash upwards with the Bloodhound's Fang, using the momentum of the strike to perform a backwards somersault and gain some distance from foes. Follow up with a strong attack to perform the Bloodhound's Step attack.

name: Dismounter
description: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.  A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.
obtain: Dropped by Kaiden Sellswords found around Limgrave (4% chance).
lore: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.
A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
description: Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales. It's said these land-bound dragons were once humans heroes who partook in dragon communication, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.
obtain: Received upon defeating Magma Wyrm Makar boss inside the Ruin-Strewn Precipice, accessed from Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales.

It's said these land-bound dragons were once human heroes who partook in dragon communion, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.
Unique Skill: Magma Guillotine

Grab the scalesword with both hands, as a wyrm would hold it in its mouth, and leap forwards, smashing it into the ground and triggering a blast of magma. Follow up with an additional input to perform a chopping attack.

name: Omen Cleaver
description: Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength.  The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorating malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.
obtain: Omen enemies have a 4% chance to drop this item.
lore: Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength.
The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorative malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.

name: Zamor Curved Sword
description: Weapon wielded by the knights of Zamor who earned great renown during the War against the Giants. In apparent devotion to winter, the curved blade is styled after an icy wind and imbued with a powerful frost effect.
obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, defeat the miniboss of the dungeon: Ancient Hero of Zamor.
lore: Weapon wielded by the knights of Zamor who earned great renown during the War against the Giants.
In apparent devotion to winter, the curved blade is styled after an icy wind and imbued with a powerful frost effect.
Unique Skill: Zamor Ice Storm
Plunge the curved sword into the ground, building power before unleashing a freezing storm that batters the surroundings.

name: Monk's Flameblade
description: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.
obtain: 4% chance to drop from the Fire Monk enemy that wields it within the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. This is the only spawn for this enemy in the game.
lore: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came out from the Mountaintops of the Giants.
The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.
loreNotes: This weapon's counterpart, the Blackflame Monk's Flameblade, was .

name: Beastman's Cleaver
description: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.
obtain: Chance to drop from Azula Beastman enemies that wield it.
lore: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.
The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.

name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
description: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.  The accused blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Omen King, gained by defeating Morgott, the Omen King, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
lore: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.
The accursed blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.
Unique Skill: Cursed-Blood Slice
Brace, then charge forward to deliver a downward diagonal slice. The bloody trail of the blade is followed by a burst of flame. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

name: Falchion
description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales. Wielders of the weapon employ a unique style that enhances attacks with spinning motions.
obtain: Demi-Humans wielding falchions have a 2% chance to drop them.
lore: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales.
Wielders of the weapon employ a unique style that enhances attacks with spinning motions.

name: Shamshir
description: Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession. A devastatingly powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.
obtain:
Location: Highroad Cave
The  is found on a corpse near two Man-Bats in a large, water-filled chamber among ancient ruins within Highroad Cave. The cave entrance lies at the northern tip of Limgrave's Murkwater River, connected to Agheel Lake.
lore: Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession.
A devastating powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.

name: Beastman's Curved Sword
description: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.
obtain: Dropped by the Azula Beastman enemies that wield it in Crumbling Farum Azula (2% chance).
lore: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.
The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.

name: Shotel
description: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.  Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield efficiently.
obtain: Abandoned Merchant in the Siofra River region (x1).
lore: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.
Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield effectively.

name: Magma Blade
description: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.
obtain: Man-Serpent enemies that wield the light-up version of this weapon have a 1% chance to drop this item.
lore: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made.
Deals fire damage.
Unique Skill: Magma Shower
Slash at foes in a twirling motion while scattering magma all around. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

name: Flowing Curved Sword
description: Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water. Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend. Skill: Spinning Slash Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
obtain:
Location: Consecrated Snowfield
The Flowing Curved Sword is found inside of the chest of a Great Coffin carriage trekking through the middle of Consecrated Snowfield.
lore: Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water.
Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend.

name: Wing Of Astel
description: Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic of the stars. Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light. Crafted from a relic of the Naturalborn of the Void who is said to have assailed the Eternal City.
obtain:
Found inside a chest in Uhl Palace Ruins above a Withered Astel, located in Ainsel River and only reachable from Ainsel River Main.
More specifically, from  Ainsel River Main site of grace and head down the tunnel. Take the left split in the road, guarded by a Hardhead Giant Ant, and follow the cliffside path to a stone structure with the chest.
lore: Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic of the stars. Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light.
Crafted from a relic of the Naturalborn of the Void who is said to have assailed the Eternal City.
Unique Skill: Nebula
Imbue the Naturalborn's wings with magic to send forth a dark cloud of stars that lingers briefly before exploding.
loreNotes: Patch 1.09 increased the Attribute scaling of this weapon.

name: Eclipse Shotel
description: Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments. In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.
obtain: Castle Sol, in the  Church of the Eclipse where there is also a grace.
lore: Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments.
In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.
Unique Skill: Death Flare
Set the lusterless sun ablaze with the Prince of Death's flames, inflicting the death ailment upon foes. Follow up with an additional input to bring down the armament, triggering an explosion.

name: Serpent-god's Curved Sword
description: Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir. Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.
obtain: Found near a giant Land Octopus inside the Ruin-Strewn Precipice, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir.
Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.

name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
description: Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles. The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.
obtain:
Location: Mt. Gelmir
Can be looted from a body at Mt. Gelmir, where all the ladders are, near the Grafted Scion.
lore: Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles.
The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.
loreNotes: The Sharktooth Curved Sword, a variant of the , was cut from the game. Although near-identical, it uses a unique item icon.

name: Mantis Blade
description: A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers.  The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.
obtain: Guaranteed drop: Cemetery Shade in the Gelmir Hero's Grave on Mt. Gelmir.
lore: A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers.
The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.

name: Scimitar
description: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.
obtain:
Starting weapon of the warrior class.
Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks for 600 Runes.
Dropped by Skeletons wielding a Scimitar and Iron Roundshield (2% chance).
lore: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales.
Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.

name: Nox Flowing Sword
description: A grim weapon wielded by swordsmen of the Eternal City, this shotel has a blade as fine as a needle. Forged from the liquid metal of a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened
obtain:
Location: Sellia, Town of Sorcery ( Chair-Crypt of Sellia)
This item becomes accessible after solving the puzzle and passing through the unlocked gate.
The  is obtained upon defeating the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk duo boss in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, located on the eastern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid.
lore: A grim weapon wielded by swordsmen of the Eternal City, this shotel has a blade as fine as a needle.
Forged from the liquid metal of a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.
Unique Skill: Flowing Form
Temporarily transforms armament into its liquid form. Swing the armament like a whip to perform a sweeping slice over a wide area.

name: Dagger
description: A standard dagger with a straight blade.  Though modest in reach and capacity fo harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.
obtain:
1 sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 400 Runes
4% drop chance from dagger-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, Haligtree Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers).
A good early farming spot is all the Highwaymen at the beginning of Murkwater Cave.
lore: A standard dagger with a straight blade.
Though modest in reach and capacity for harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.

name: Grossmesser
description: Curved sword boasting a large blade.  This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.  A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.
obtain:
Dropped by Skeleton enemies that wield it (2% chance). They will solely be armed with the Grossmesser.
One Skeleton wielding the weapon can be found immediately past the Site of Grace in the Tombsward Catacombs, behind the seal imposed by an Imp Statue, unlocked by a Stonesword Key. There are more inside the catacombs.
lore: Curved sword boasting a large blade. This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.
A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.

name: Black Knife
description: Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives.  A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.
obtain: Received upon defeating the Black Knife Assassin in front of Sainted Hero's Grave located in Altus Plateau.
lore: Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives.
A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.
Unique Skill: Blade of Death

Unleash the power of the Rune of Death to fire off a blade-like projectile. In addition to dealing immediate damage, the blade reduces the enemy's maximum HP and continues to wear down HP for a while.
loreNotes: While the Black Knife is a legendary item, it does not count as one of the Legendary Armaments (Achievement/Trophy).

name: Parrying Dagger
description: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.  For master of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.
obtain: 1 can be bought from Patches for 1,600 Runes in any of his locations (Murkwater Cave is the earliest).
lore: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.
For masters of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.

name: Miséricorde
description: Dagger favored by military physicians in white.  The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent.  Medicine is mercy. and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothes as men of compassion
obtain: Found behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open, near the roaming Grafted Scion inside Stormveil Castle and the elevator shortcut back up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
lore: Dagger favored by military physicians in white. The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent.
Medicine is mercy, and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothed as men of compassion.
loreNotes: The name of this dagger is French for "mercy", signifying its use for giving the death stroke to heavily wounded knights, an "act of mercy".
"Dagger of Mercy" is a literal translation of the Japanese name.
This weapon was popular among speedrunners before the heavy nerf to the Stance damage of Flame of the Redmanes (from 40 to 10), due to the power of its critical hits.

name: Reduvia
description: Jagged dagger with a distinctive curled blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.
obtain:
Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus near Murkwater Cave once defeated.
Beware that progressing through the game can prevent this invasion from happening, more specifically by defeating all the major Limgrave bosses (Flying Dragon Agheel, Mad Pumpkin Head, Margit, the Fell Omen, Tibia Mariner, and Tree Sentinel).
lore: Jagged dagger with a distinctive curved blade. Used by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood.
This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.
Unique Skill: Reduvia Blood Blade
Slash with the wicked dagger, transforming its never-drying bloodstains into airborne blood blades that cause hemorrhaging. Can be fired in rapid succession.

name: Crystal Knife
description: A knife made by sharpening hard crystal. Signature weapon of glintstone miners.  Used as a tool to extract glintstone from broken rock, and as such a faint magic enwreathes the blade.
obtain: Found in a chest inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel located in Liurnia of the Lakes. After taking the first elevator after the Site of Grace down and walking across a wooden beam it is inside the second room on the right, guarded by two distracted Marionette Soldiers.
lore: A knife made by sharpening hard crystal. Signature weapon of glintstone miners.
Used as tool to extract glintstone from broken rock, and as such a faint magic enwreathes the blade.
loreNotes: Despite the description mentioning that this weapon is used to remove to remove glintstones, it's never seen being used that way.

name: Celebrant's Sickle
description: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-coloured fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.
obtain:
Location: Altus Plateau
Celebrant's Sickle has a 0.5% random chance to drop from blue-garbed Dominula Dancers that wield it in Dominula, Windmill Village, located on the Altus Plateau.
Two of them are found a bit east of the  Windmill Village Site of Grace.
lore: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.
Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.
loreNotes: Likely a homage to the Needle of Eternal Agony from Demon's Souls.

name: Glintstone Kris
description: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.
obtain:
Location: Raya Lucaria Grand Library
Received if siding with Sorceress Sellen against Castellan Jerren in Academy of Raya Lucaria near the end of her questline.
lore: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace.
Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.
Unique Skill: Glintstone Dart
Skill that builds from the Glintstone Pebble sorcery. Charge the skill to upgrade it to Glintstone Dart. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust.

name: Scorpion's Stinger
description: Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot. A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god.
obtain:
Location: Grand Cloister
The  is stored within a chest beneath a massive, scarlet rot-infested statue of the nameless, bearded god of the ancient dynasty within the Grand Cloister, located on the Lake of Rot.
A large group of Kindred of Rot worship toward the relic, which lies inside the central shrine west of the  Grand Cloister site of grace.
lore: Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot.
A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god.
loreNotes: In Game Version 1.00 this weapon instead had Quickstep as its skill, and the description referred to it inflicting Poison (though it didn't have any Status Effect build-up).

name: Great Knife
description: Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to Spinning Slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.
obtain:
Starting equipment for the Bandit class.
2% drop chance from Small Demi-Humans.
The earliest farming spot is just inside Lakeside Crystal Cave, where once can be found hiding inside of a bush next to another, regular Demi-Human.
The most efficient farming spot is just north of the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace on Mt. Gelmir, where four of them are hiding amongst a flock of Sheep.
lore: Large knife with a broad, curved blade.
This weapon is designed to slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.

name: Wakizashi
description: Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Afflicts targets with blood loss. These swords are considered auxiliary weapons. Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordsman known only as Okina.
obtain:
Found on a corpse inside a locked cell in Gaol Cave, located in Caelid. The cave requires one Stonesword Key to access.
From the lever that unlocks all the cages it can be found by taking a right then a left, and then it's one of three items in the second cage on the left.
lore: Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of the Reeds. Afflicts targets with blood loss.
These swords are considered auxiliary weapons. Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordman known only as Okina.

name: Cinquedea
description: Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. Raises potency of bestial incantations. The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.
obtain:
Location: Bestial Sanctum (exterior)
The  is looted from a mummified Beastman behind the Bestial Sanctum in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow.
Descend onto roots from the north-facing cliff behind the Bestial Sanctum, located on the west side of the building.
Carefully jump from the roots onto the domes of the pillars, before carefully dropping along the pillar to the row of pit graves.
Travel down to the third row, and reach fhe platform with four chained Beastmen.
Rainbow Stones can be used to determine the safety of a fall.
Found on the same level as the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
lore: Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. Raises potency of bestial incantations.
The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.
loreNotes: The name cinquedea means "five fingers" in Italian, referring to the width of the blade at the handle.

name: Ivory Sickle
description: Sickle fashioned form ivory.  Weapon carried by aged Albunaurics. These weapons re evidence of their dedication to the Haligtree, despite never having entered its presence.
obtain:
Location: Village of the Albinaurics
The  is looted from a stone coffin atop a hill at the Village of the Albinaurics, located beneath the Moonlight Altar in southwestern Liurnia of the Lakes. The item is near Old Albus and the  Village of the Albinaurics site of grace. Beware the Depraved Perfumer.
lore: Sickle fashioned from ivory. Weapon carried by aged Albinaurics.
These weapons are evidence of their dedication to the Haligtree, despite never having entered its presence.

name: Erdsteel Dagger
description: An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace.  Though forged to a high standard, the weapon is difficult to wield.  Attack power also scales with faith.
obtain:
Received from Kenneth Haight after helping him retake Fort Haight.
Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital in the sewer area under the wing of Gransax near a fire-spitting Gargoyle Statue. From the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, proceed northwest along the avenue and drop down in the pit to the far left.
lore: An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace.
Though forged to a high standard, the weapon is difficult to wield. Attack power also scales with faith.

name: Blade Of Calling
description: Dagger given to one who set out on a journey to fulfill her duty long ago. The power of its former owner, the kindling maiden, is still apparent. The one who walks alongside flame, Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.
obtain:
Loot: Forbidden Lands
Hidden within a room that you can only reach during the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace, alongside the Official's Attire.
Jump from the southwestern part of the elevator to a doorway just above the bottom floor.
lore: Dagger given to one who set out on a journey to fulfill her duty long ago. The power of its former owner, the kindling maiden, is still apparent.

The one who walks alongside flame,
Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.
Unique Skill: Blade of Gold
Leap into the air, charging the armament with golden flames that are then shot at the enemy as a single, blade-like projectile. Inflicts holy damage.
loreNotes: This dagger belonged to Melina. Curiously, another copy is wielded by Polyanna, one of Millicent's Sisters.
The cost of the skill was reduced from 20 FP to 17 FP at an unknown point as an unlisted change.

name: Bloodstained Dagger
description: Dagger with a bloodstained blade. Afflicts targets with blood loss. As blood darkened the dagger through repeated slashing and stabbing, its blade only grew sharper and harder.
obtain:
2% drop rate from Fierce Demi-Humans aka Demi-Human Chiefs.
One can point asleep next to the bridge west of the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.
lore: Dagger with a bloodstained blade. Afflicts targets with blood loss.
As blood darkened the dagger through repeated slashing and stabbing, its blade only grew sharper and harder.

name: Spiked Caestus
description: A Caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes. Fists weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will it to both hands.
obtain: Sold by the Isolated Merchant in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow for 4000 runes, or by the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Isolated Merchant's Bell Bearing 3.
lore: A caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes.
Fist weapons come in pair, and two-handling this weapon will equip it in both hands.

name: Caestus
description: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.
obtain: Sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc in Stormveil Castle, or by the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Gostoc's Bell Bearing, for 800 runes.
lore: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of rough leather inlaid with iron rivets.
Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handling this weapon will equip it to both hands.

name: Grafted Dragon
description: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was granted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.
obtain: Grafted Dragon is one of the two options that can be obtained by turning in Remembrance of the Grafted with  2,000 Runes to Finger Reader Enia. The Remembrance can be duplicated by using the Remembrance of the Grafted at Wandering Mausoleums to acquire both the Grafted Dragon and the Axe of Godrick.
lore: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was grafted to Godrick's left arm.
The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.
Unique Skill: Bear Witness!
Grant the small dragon a fleeting glimpse of life and thrust it skyward, spewing flames over a wide frontward area.

name: Iron Ball
description: Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice. Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.
obtain: Received upon killing Blackguard Big Boggart. The weapon will have the Braggart's Roar Ash of War with the standard affinity infused into it.
lore: Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice.
Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.

name: Star Fist
description: Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss.  Used in brutal games of pugilism.
obtain: Can be looted from a corpse inside an arched alcove on the left side of the main entrance to the Royal Colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
lore: Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss.
Used in brutal games of pugilism.

name: Katar
description: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.
obtain: Found inside a chest in Fort Gael, located in southwestern Caelid. The Katar can be found by dropping down to the area overlooking the Elder Lion and entering the dark room.
lore: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.

name: Clinging Bone
description: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. ""O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.""
obtain: Received upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains.
lore: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains.
Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. "O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.
Skill: Lifesteal Fist

Skill that demonstrate mastery of the art of controlling vital energies. A slow, controlled punch with an energy-infused fist that renders foes unconcious and steals their HP. Only effective against foes of human build.

name: Cipher Pata
description: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.
obtain: Roundtable Hold, jumping over the balcony rail, it will be in the rooms to the left
lore: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage.
The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.
Unique Skill: Unblockable Blade
Imbue the cipher blade with light, then lunge forward with a sudden piercing attack. This attack cannot be blocked.

name: Veteran's Prosthesis
