description: Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist. Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.
obtain: Defeat Commander Niall in Castle Sol.
lore: Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist.
Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of the defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.
Unique Skill: Storm Kick
Thrust the prosthetic leg blade into the ground, creating a storm. Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lightning-infused jumping attack.
loreNotes: While the English item description mentions that Niall offered up his prosthesis in exchange for the lives of the knights, the Japanese description says that he exchanged his leg.

name: Nightrider Flail
description: A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads.   Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. The large spikes make it highly effective at inducing blood loss, but also demand higher dexterity to wield.
obtain: Drop from the Weeping Peninsula Night's Cavalry, found near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace at night.
lore: A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.
The large spikes make it highly effective at inducing blood loss, but also demand higher dexterity to wield.

name: Flail
description: Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss.  Blows from this weapon cannot be parried. The charge attack whirls the iron ball around for increased force before striking.
obtain: Found at Gatefront Ruins, located in the black carriage furthest east from Gatefront's marker. Also dropped by Brother Corhyn at his death or at the end of his questline.
lore: Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by a chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss.
Blows from this weapon cannot be parried. The charge attack whirls the iron ball around for increased force before striking.

name: Family Heads
description: Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage. The heads were made to resemble those of his wife and two children.
obtain: Received upon defeating Necromancer Garris, who is found behind an illusory wall inside the Sage's Cave, located in Altus Plateau.
lore: Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage.
The heads were made to resemble those of his wife and two children.
Unique Skill: Familial Rancor
Gently rattle the copper heads to summon vengeful spirits that chase down foes. The anguish of a spouse and children invites accursed wrath.
loreNotes: The Attributes scaling for the weapon when upgraded to +10 spells out DAD, which might be a reference to how Garris himself is a father and how the weapon was made to resemble his lost family.

name: Bastard's Stars
description: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel. Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.
obtain:
Trade Remembrance of the Naturalborn, dropped by Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
lore: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel.
Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.
Unique Skill: Nebula
Imbue the Naturalborn's stars with magic to perform a sweeping strike. This attack leaves a dark cloud of stars in its wake that lingers briefly before exploding.
loreNotes: The Bastard's Stars portrays a Finger of God.

name: Glintstone Staff
description: Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.
obtain:
Starting equipement for the Prisoner class.
2% chance to be dropped by the Wandering Noble Sorcerers, such as the one south of Waypoint Ruins, next to a broken tower. They are also among the caravan following the two Trolls pulling the carriage in Limgrave.
lore: Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.
Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

name: Crystal Staff
description: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceris. The Crystalian's faint cognition is know as the "wisdom of stone." This staff can only be weilded by those of intellect high enough to grasp such wisdom.
obtain: Found in a treasure chest inside the Academy Crystal Cave, located near the Crystalline Woods grace, in Liurnia of the Lakes. The cave requires 2 Stonesword Keys to enter. The chest is behind an illusory wall to the left after entering the room with a Battlemage.
lore: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.
The Crystalian's faint cogitation is known as the "wisdom of stone." This staff can only be wielded by those of intellect high enough to grasp such wisdom.

name: Chainlink Flail
description: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads. Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by the Mad Pumpkin Head enemies that wield it.
lore: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads.
Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.

name: Gelmir Glintstone Staff
description: Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.  The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.
obtain: 10% chance to be dropped by the shell-helmed Gelmir Man-Serpent in the throne room of Volcano Manor, right before the sending gate leading to Rykard's area.
lore: Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.
The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.

name: Demi-human Queen's Staff
description: Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence. Sneered at by fools in the academy.
obtain: Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen at the Demi-Human Forest Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula.
lore: Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence.
Sneered at by fools in the academy.

name: Carian Regal Scepter
description: Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries. Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, gained by defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
lore: Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries.
Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.
Unique Skill: Spinning Weapon
Channel magic into the glintstone to suspend the scepter in mid air and cause it to spin violently. Those it touches will suffer successive magic attacks.

name: Astrologer's Staff
description: Staff of the astrologers. A glintsone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.
obtain:
Starting equipment for the Astrologer origin.
Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace in the Liurnia of the Lakes for 800 Runes.
lore: Staff of the astrologers. A glintstone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.
Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

name: Digger's Staff
description: Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone.   Boosts the power of Stonedigger sorceries
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by various Glintstone Miners like those in Sellia Crystal Tunnel, located in Caelid. The larger variant has a 4% chance to drop it.
lore: Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone.
Boosts the power of Stonedigger sorceries.

name: Prince Of Death's Star
description: Staff embedded with sullied amber, said to be a very part of the Prince of Death. Enhances death sorceries. One of the staves deemed heretical by the academy for its ability to allow sorceries to be augmented through faith in addition to intelligence.

name: Carian Glintblade Staff
description: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Gifted to enchanted knights, it enhances Glintblade sorceries.
obtain:
Located on top of the Highway Lookout Tower, east of Liurnia of the Lakes.
ru:Карианский посох блестящего клинка
lore: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff.
Gifted to enchanted knights, it enhances Glintblade sorceries.

name: Albinauric Staff
description: Short staff with a blue glintstone embedded. Wielded by the albinaurics of old.  The albinaurics harbor a secret; they cast sorcery with their innate arcaneness.
obtain:
Location: Volcano Manor (Prison Town)
The  is found on a corpse at the Prison Town of the Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir, near the  Guest Hall site of grace.
From the  Guest Hall, head left twice, climb the stairs, exit outside, turn left, and climb the ladder to reach the roof. Drop onto the east balcony and enter the torch-lit, open doorway to find the item. Beware the Omenkiller.
lore: Short staff with a blue glintstone embedded. Wielded by the Albinaurics of old.
The Albinaurics harbor a secret; they cast sorcery using their innate arcaneness.

name: Academy Glintstone Staff
description: Staff of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, embedded with a turquoise glintstone. Only a recognized sorcerer is permitted to wield this staff.
obtain:
Dropped by Thops, either by killing him in the Church of Irith or upon finishing his questline, inside the Academy of Raya Lucaria near the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace.
2% chance to be dropped by various Glintstone Sorcerers that wield it.
ru:Блестящий посох академии
lore: Staff of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, embedded with a turquoise glintstone.
Only a recognized sorcerer is permitted to wield this staff.

name: Carian Glintstone Staff
description: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff. Given to sorcerers that they might enact the role of knight. Enhances Carian sword sorceries.
obtain: Looted from a corpse on a bench on the circular balcony within the Carian Study Hall, east of Liurnia of the Lakes, prior to inversion.
lore: Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff.
Given to sorcerers that they might enact the role of knight. Enhances Carian sword sorceries.
loreNotes: This item was originally called "Carian Sorcerer Staff" in the Closed Network Test.

name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
description: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Azur. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it. Reduces casting time of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.
obtain:
Found in a secluded room on the highest level of the Church of the Cuckoo. The level can be accessed via the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
From the Debate Parlor site of grace, go outside to the left until you meet two Raya Lucaria Sorcerers. Jump down on the stairs next to them. Continue forward until you can jump onto the rooftops. Then, proceed further and go up the ladder at the end of said rooftops.
After the sorcerer, go down on the rooftops again, until you can see a dome-like structure that has windows. Go through one of the windows, and descend onto the lower floor. One of
lore: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Azur. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it.
Reduces casting time of sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
description: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom ofstone may wield it. Enhances power ofall sorceries, but consumes additional FP.
obtain: Found inside a chest after the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk duo boss fight in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, located in Caelid.
lore: Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it.
Enhances power of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

name: Meteorite Staff
description: Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well. However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.
obtain:
Location: Street of Sages Ruins
The  is looted from a corpse inside a broken tower on the southwest side of the Street of Sages Ruins, located within the northwestern quadrant of the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid.
lore: Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well.
However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.

name: Staff Of The Guilty
description: A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glinstone. Similar to hex magic. Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when weilding this staff which enhances Thorn sorceries in particular.
obtain:
2.00% chance to be dropped by Guilty Sorcerers that wield this weapon, such as the ones near the Seethewater Terminus grace, located in Mt. Gelmir.
? % chance to drop from Guilty in .
lore: A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glintstone. Similar to hex magic.
Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when wielding this staff which enhances thorn sorceries in particular.

name: Rotten Crystal Staff
description: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.
obtain:
8% chance to be dropped by Putrid Crystalian Mages such as the one near the Elphael Inner Wall grace, located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
Another Putrid Crystalian Mage can be found by going down to the lower eastern rampart where a Rotten Avatar patrols and running north up the stairs and into the building. Since there are no spear-wielding Crystalians nearby and the Avatar does not respawn, it can be safer to grind for the staff from this one instead of the one in the inner wall. If you are simultaneously grinding for the Rotten Crystal Spear, however, the Inner Wall grace is better.
lore: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.
Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

name: Greataxe
description: Greatxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains. Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to behold.
obtain: Inside the carriage hauled by two Trolls on the road close to the Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave. The carriage must be stopped before the chest can be opened, requiring both trolls be killed. These trolls will not pursue the Tarnished, instead choosing to focus on pulling the carriage. Instead, they will stomp to try and punish the Tarnished for being attacked before going back to pulling, leaving the Tarnished to focus simply on avoiding being truck by their retort between attacks.
lore: Greataxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains.
Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to be behold.

name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
description: The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omen ktillers. The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.
obtain:
Received upon defeating the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom duo boss inside the Perfumer's Grotto located in Altus Plateau.
Dropped from the Omenkiller in Volcano Manor. He stands near a crematory pyre in the middle of the collection of buildings to the right after exiting the  Prison Town Church.
lore: The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omenkillers.
The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.

name: Staff Of Loss
description: Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism. This staff is only capable of casting invisibility sorceries, but that is reason enough for some to wield it.
obtain: Found on a corpse on a balcony in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, located in Caelid.
lore: Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism.
This staff only distinguishes itself when casting invisibility sorceries, but that is reason enough for some to wield it.

name: Crescent Moon Axe
description: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia. Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by the larger Exile Soldiers that wield them in Stormveil Castle.
lore: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia.
Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.

name: Axe Of Godrick
description: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage. "I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"
obtain: The Axe of Godrick is one of the options that can be obtained by turning in the Remembrance of the Grafted to Finger Reader Enia. The Remembrance can be duplicated at Wandering Mausoleums which possess a bell in order to obtain both options.
lore: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage.
"I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"
Unique Skill: I Command Thee, Kneel!
Repeatedly smash the Axe of Godrick into the ground, unleashing two earth-shaking shockwaves. Follow up with an additional input to produce a third shockwave.

name: Longhaft Axe
description: Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten. Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.
obtain: 2% chance to drop from the larger, Scaly Misbegotten enemies that wield it. One of them can be found atop the pile of bodies in the Castle Morne courtyard.
lore: Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten.
Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.

name: Executioner's Greataxe
description: Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.
obtain: Axe-wielding skeleton enemies have a 4% chance to drop this item.
lore: Bulky cleaver welded to a long shaft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated enemies, felling them like timber.
Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.
loreNotes: The Executioner’s Greataxe strongly resembles the Dragonslayer Greataxe wielded by the Dragonslayer Armour in Dark Souls III and its second DLC expansion, The Ringed City.

name: Rusted Anchor
description: A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks. While the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Kird, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.
obtain: Dropped by the Scaly Misbegotten area boss in Morne Tunnel.
lore: A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks.
When the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Lord, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.

name: Winged Greathorn
description: A unique horn in which the power of ancestral spirit fiercly dwells, this large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as weapon of spirit worship.  In the ancestral spirit-woshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor, obtained by defeating the Regal Ancestor Spirit, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate it (only one can be obtained per playthrough using either method).
lore: A unique horn in which the power of ancestral spirits fiercely dwells, this large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as a weapon of spirit worship.
In the ancestral spirit-worshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.
Unique Skill: Soul Stifler
Raise the greathorn's wings to summon a soul-sapping miasma. Enemies in the affected area will temporarily suffer from reduced defense.

name: Butchering Knife
description: Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden.  Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.
obtain: Received upon defeating Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater near the Corpse-Stench Shack on Mt. Gelmir, with the Sacred affinity added to the weapon.
lore: Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden.
Restores a small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.

name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
description: Description  "Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyle. Just like the wielder, the missing part have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions."
obtain: Received upon defeating the Valiant Gargoyle found on the stairway northeast of the  Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace, located in the Capital Outskirts.
lore: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.
Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

name: Lion Greatbow
description: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with .  Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge, gained by defeating Starscourge Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough either way).
lore: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion motif.
Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.
Unique Skill: Radahn's Rain
Archery skill performed from a low stance. Ready the bow and fire a sudden flurry of arrows up into the sky. The arrows will pour on foes like rain.
loreNotes: Patch 1.09 increased this weapon's scaling values.

name: Erdtree Greatbow
description: Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.
obtain: Received upon destroying the Merciless Chariot within the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave. You must use a ranged weapon to shoot a wire, causing explosive great jars to drop. You have limited attempts and must time your shot.
lore: Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow.
Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

name: Golem Greatbow
description: Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem. Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.
obtain: 10% chance to drop from Guardian Golems that wield it.
lore: Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem.
Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.

name: Greatbow
description: Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary. A greatbow can only fire great arrows.
obtain:
Found inside a chest on top of the Highway Lookout Tower located in northeastern Altus Plateau.
4% chance to drop from various bow-wielding Knights.
lore: Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary.
A greatbow can only fire great arrows.

name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear
description: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.
obtain: Trade the Remembrance of the Blood Lord, dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood, with Finger Reader Enia.
lore: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty.
As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.
Unique Skill: Bloodboon Ritual

Raise the sacred spear and pierce the body of the Formless Mother. Stab up to three times, creating explosions of blood with each thrust. This skill will coat the armament with bloodflame for a while.

name: Siluria's Tree
description: Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. The primordial form of the Erdtree is close in nature to life itself, and this spear, modeled on its crucible, is imbued with ancient holy essence.
obtain: Received upon defeating Crucible Knight Siluria at the Deeproot Depths. She guards a giant hollow tree trunk to the southwest of the Nameless Eternal City.
lore: Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights.
The primordial form of the Erdtree is close in nature to life itself, and this spear, modeled on its crucible, is imbued with ancient holy essence.
Unique Skill: Siluria's Woe
Thrust the weapon in a spiraling motion, surrounding it in a vortex of wind. Charged attacks have the power to blow away enemies and can fire the tornado forwards.

name: Vyke's War Spear
description: War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold. Like Vyke himself, it has been tormented by the yellow flame of frenzy from within.
obtain: Received upon defeating Festering Fingerprint Vyke at the Church of Inhibition in northeastern Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold.
Like Vyke himself, it has been tormented by the yellow flame of frenzy from within.
Unique Skill: Frenzyflame Thrust
Imbue the spear with the flame of frenzy and leap forwards, plunging it into the ground and setting off a maddening explosion. The skill inflicts both the enemy and the user with madness.

name: Serpent-hunter
description: Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.
obtain:
Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
Loot: Can be picked up within the boss arena of Praetor Rykard, just after the fog gate.
This item does not re-spawn when the player has one in either their inventory or chest, even in NG+. However it will re-spawn (and thus can be picked up again) from the same location should the player discard it. This is to make sure that the player always have the means of fighting Rykard with it.
Because of this safeguard it is still possible to obtain duplicates of this weapon:
Requirements:
The player needs to not have a copy it in their inventory.
