lore: Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature.
When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.
Unique Skill: Great-Serpent Hunt
Perform a powerful forward lunge and follow up with an upward thrust via additional input. When fighting a great serpent, a long blade of light will appear, revealing the armament's true power.
loreNotes: The Serpent Hunter strongly resembles the Dragonslayer Swordspear wielded by the Nameless King in FromSoftware’s previous game Dark Souls III.
The shape of the weapon's blade resembles the Karasawa laser rifle from FromSoftware's mecha series Armored Core.

name: Lance
description: Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce. Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.
obtain: Found on a corpse on top of a fallen ruin by a camp, northeast of the Warmaster's Shack located in Limgrave.
lore: Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce.
Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.

name: Treespear
description: Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Deals only holy damage.  Requiring superior dexterity to wield, this greatspear can perform consecutive thrust attacks despite its larger size.
obtain: Found inside a chest in a carriage on a collapsed bridge south of the Liurnia Highway South Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Deals holy damage.
Requiring superior dexterity to wield, this greatspear can perform consecutive thrust attacks despite its larger size.

name: Bastard Sword
description: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is normally wielded with two hands, but those with sufficient strength can wield it in one alone. The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.
obtain: Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region.
lore: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient.
The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.

name: Forked Greatsword
description: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue"                   and causes blood loss.
obtain: Wolf Head Imp golems have a 2% chance (at 100 discovery) to drop this weapon. One such Imp can be found immediately near the Site of Grace in the Road's End Catacombs.
lore: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps.
The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

name: Iron Greatsword
description: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept. Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.
obtain: s are dropped by Misbegotten Warrior enemies (4.00% chance).
lore: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept.
Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.

name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Through blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.
obtain: Found at Gatefront Ruins, located in the black carriage closest to Gatefront's marker, just to the west.
lore: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army.
Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.
loreNotes: It has the same description as Lordsworn's Straight Sword.

name: Knight's Greatsword
description: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.
obtain: Dropped by chance from the following enemies: Godrick Knights, Cuckoo Knights, Leyndell Knights and Mausoleum Knights.
lore: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title.
Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.

name: Flamberge
description: Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation. Shreds enemy flesh, inducing blood loss.  Scarlet rot is kept at bay with flame at Redmane Castle, and as such, this beloved sword of Jerren's eventually became the symbol of the castle itself.
obtain: Redmane Castle, on a body that's on top of the building upstairs from the gateway portal to the right, up the ladder.
lore: Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation. Shred enemy flesh, inducing blood loss.
Scarlet rot is kept at bay with flame at Redmane Castle, and as such, this beloved sword of Jerren's eventually became the symbol of the castle itself.

name: Ordovis's Greatsword
description: Greatsword of Ordovis, one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. This sword is imbued with an ancient holy essence. Its red tint exemplifies the nature of primordial gold, said to be close in nature to life itself.
obtain: Ordovis's Greatsword is received upon defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis and Crucible Knight duo boss in the Auriza Hero's Grave, located in the Capital Outskirts.
lore: Greatsword of Ordovis, one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights.
This sword is imbued with an ancient holy essence. Its red tint exemplifies the nature of primordial gold, said to be closer in nature to life itself.
Unique Skill: Ordovis's Vortex
Channel the power of the crucible to spin the sword in midair, building momentum before slamming the blade down onto the ground. This skill can be charged to increase its power.
loreNotes: This weapon's name was originally spelled "Ordovis' Greatsword" during the Closed Network Test.

In the Closed Network Test, the description mentioned that there were a total of 16 Crucible Knights, which remains true in the base game. The total count increased to 17 with the release of , and 19 with .

name: Alabaster Lord's Sword
description: Greatsword forged from a blue-white meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Alabaster Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.
obtain:
Location: Lake of Rot
Defeat the Alabaster Lord in the Lake of Rot (will not drop if the Lord is killed at the same time as the player) to obtain the . He is on top of a large Ancient Dynasty structure.
Random Drop:
Defeat Alabaster Lords in Yelough Anix Tunnel.
lore: Greatsword forged from a blue-white meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic.
A weapon unique to the Alabaster Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.
Unique Skill: Alabaster Lord's Pull
Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack pulls enemies in. Has a greater area of effect than Gravitas.

name: Banished Knight's Greatsword
description: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
obtain: Dropped by Banished Knights wielding it in Stormveil Castle and Castle Sol, located in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
lore: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.
Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

name: Dark Moon Greatsword
description: A Moon Greatsword, bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments. Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.
obtain: Received at the end of the Lunar Princess Ranni questline.
lore: A Moon Greatsword bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments.
Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.
Unique Skill: Moonlight Greatsword
Raise the sword aloft, bathing it in the light of the dark moon. Temporarily increases magic attack power and imbues blade with frost. Charged attack release blasts of moonlight.
loreNotes: The Dark Moon Greatsword is Elden Ring’s version of the Moonlight Greatsword, which has appeared in multiple other FromSoftware games. Additionally, the name of the sword’s Unique Skill also alludes to this.

The Chinese and Korean release of the game preserve a very different earlier draft of this item description, roughly translating to "A greatsword of guidance bestowed on Ranni the Witch by the Two Fingers. The very Rune of Mind that will lead the next generation." The role of Carian matrimonial sword was instead filled by the Sword of Night and Flame.

name: Sacred Relic Sword
description: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.  Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think of it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.
obtain:
Trade the Elden Remembrance, dropped by Elden Beast, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
lore: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.
Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of a great devastation. Some think it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.
Unique Skill: Wave of Gold
Imbue the sword with bygone golden glory, then fire it at foes. A wide, golden wave fans out forwards, sweeping through all enemies caught in its path.

name: Helphen's Steeple
description: Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world. The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.
obtain: Dropped by a Tibia Mariner on the Mountaintops of the Giants, near Castle Sol, not far from the  Snow Valley Ruins Overlook grace and where you fight the Death Rite Bird.
lore: Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world.
The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.
Unique Skill: Ruinous Ghostflame
Swing the sword to bathe its blade in ghostflame. The ghostflame adds magic damage to attacks, and also has a bitterly cold bite.
loreNotes: The Chinese and Korean release of the game preserve a very different earlier draft of this item description, roughly translating to "Greatsword in the shape of the jet-black memorial spire which comforts the spirits of heroes who died under the Rune of Life's curse. This sword hosts the black flame that embodies the spirits." It is worth noting that the term "black flame" included Ghostflame and the flames of Destined Death in earlier drafts, rather than exclusively referring to Godslayer incantations.

name: Blasphemous Blade
description: Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade. Now they share the same blood, bound together as family. Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Blasphemous, dropped by Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
ru:Богохульный клинок
lore: Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade.
Now they share the same blood, bound together as family. Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.
Unique Skill: Taker's Flames
Raise the sacred sword aloft to set it ablaze with blasphemous flames, then bring it down to fire off a forward blast. The flames steal HP from those they touch.

name: Marais Executioner's Sword
description: Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle. One of the legendary armaments. Elemer of the Briar, the Bell Bearing Hunter, snatched the sword from the site of his looming execution, and furnished it with battle skills from his home of Eochaid..
obtain: Defeat Elemer of the Briar.
lore: Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle. One of the legendary armaments.
Elemer of the Briar, the Bell Bearing Hunter, snatched the sword from the site of his looming execution, and furnished it with battle skills from his home of Eochaid.
Unique Skill: Eochaid's Dancing Blade
Infuse the sword with energy, then fling it forwards in a corkscrew attack. The sword continuously deals damage while violently spinning. Charge the attack to increase reach and duration of the spin.

name: Sword Of Milos
description: Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone. The spines along each side of the blade have been tapered to a fine point and mete out wounds like a lopside saw-blade. Milos was indersized for a giant, and was viewed as sullied and terribly gortesque.
obtain:
Can be acquired in two different, mutually exclusive ways:
Dropped by the Dung Eater when he invades in the southern end of the moat in Capital Outskirts, at the spot where Blackguard Big Boggart normally sits.
Alternatively also dropped by the Dung Eater if he is killed in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds before the invasion, along with the Omen Set.
lore: Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone. The spines along each side of the blade have been tapered to a fine point and mete out wounds like a lopsided saw-blade.
Milos was undersized for a giant, and was viewed as sullied and terribly grotesque.
Unique Skill: Shriek of Milos
Lets out a horrific cursed scream that reduces all damage negation and status resistances for nearby foes. While active, strong attacks will change to a combo attack.

name: Golden Order Greatsword
description: Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by King Consort Radagon to proudly symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order. One of the legendary armaments. Telltale signs betray that this was once the greatsword bequeathed to him by his first wife, Rennala.
obtain: Received upon defeating the Misbegotten Crusader in Cave of the Forlorn, located in the Consecrated Snowfield.
lore: Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by the King Consort Radagon to proudly symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order. One of the legendary armaments.
Telltale signs betray that this was once the greatsword bequeathed to him by his first wife, Rennala.
Unique Skill: Establish Order
Raise the armament in salute, releasing a golden explosion. Repeated inputs send out waves of golden light.
loreNotes: Despite its description saying it is made of pure light it is actually of average weight among the Greatswords and is not one of the game's two weightless weapons, the Coded Sword and the Cipher Pata.

The Chinese and Korean release of the game preserve a very different earlier draft of this item description, roughly translating to "A greatsword guided by the one and only Rune of Life. The overflowing golden light became a blade without substance. The embodiment of the power of the Erdtree itself." The role of Carian matrimonial sword was instead filled by the Sword of Night and Flame.

name: Claymore
description: A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient. In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust making this a versatile weapon.
obtain:
Location: Castle Morne
The  is found at Castle Morne in a room attached to the central courtyard, tucked behind the burning pile of bodies. After ascending the elevator, march forward to the top of the hill, circle it clockwise, and continue onward past the palisades and through the doorway lit by a wall torch. The item is stored within a treasure chest behind several wooden barricades in a corner to the left. The misbegotten may follow the player into this room, depending on their route.
lore: A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient.
In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust, making this a versatile weapon.

name: Gargoyle's Greatsword
description: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyle.  Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
obtain:
Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss at the Siofra Aqueduct.
ru:Двуручник горгулий
lore: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.
Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

name: Death's Poker
description: Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds. The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.
obtain: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Caelid, located southeast of the  Aeonia Swamp Site of Grace. The bird spawns only at night.
lore: Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds.
The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.
Unique Skill: Ghostflame Ignition
Thrust out the barbed rod and set its tip alight with ghostflame. Follow up with a normal attack to set the ground ablaze with ghostflame, or a strong attack to trigger a massive explosion.

name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
description: Broze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyle mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.  Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
obtain:
Dropped upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred guarding the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid.
ru:Чёрный двуручник горгулий
lore: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.
Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
Unique Skill: Corpse Wax Cutter
Lost skill of ancient heroes. Lift the sword up high to release the power of corpse wax and launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile.

name: Pest's Glaive
description: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation. Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by Kindred of Rot.
lore: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation.
Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.

name: Halberd
description: A long-handed polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.  Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.
obtain:
Starting equipment of the Vagabond class.
One is sold by the Nomadic Merchant east of  Saintsbridge for  1200 Runes.
lore: A long-handed polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.
Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks, or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.

name: Lucerne
description: This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor. Though designed mainly as a thrusting weapon, its long handle can be utilized to get around an enemy's guard with a sideward sweeping attack.
obtain: Found north of the  Liurnia Highway North grace in Liurnia of the Lakes, near a broken carriage in an old battlefield.
lore: This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor.
Though designed mainly as a thrusting weapon, its long handle can be utilized to get around an enemy's guard with a sideward sweeping attack.

name: Banished Knight's Halberd
description: A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
obtain:
+8 version dropped by Edgar when he is killed either at Castle Morne or at the Revenger's Shack.
4% chance to be dropped by Banished Knights that wield it. One can be found near the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle.
lore: A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.
Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

name: Commander's Standard
description: A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd. Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.
obtain: Received upon defeating Commander O'Neil in the centre of the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid.
lore: A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd.
Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.
Unique Skill: Rallying Standard
Hoist the war banner aloft and give a rallying command. Raises attack power and defense for self and nearby allies.

name: Ripple Crescent Halberd
description: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics. The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.
obtain: Second-Generation Albinaurics wielding  have a 2.00% chance to drop the weapon on death.
lore: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics.
The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.

name: Nightrider Glaive
description: A jet-black glaive with a blade as weighty as a bludgeon. Weapon of the Night's Vavalry who ride funeral seeds.  This glaive excels at weighty slash attacks that crash into foes, making it a powerful weapon even on horse back.
obtain: Dropped alongside the Ash of War: Giant Hunt by a Night's Cavalry miniboss in Liurnia of the Lakes, who patrols immediately north of the  East Raya Lucaria Gate grace where the Finger Reader Crone is. The cavalry only spawns during nighttime.
lore: A jet-black glaive with a blade as weighty as a bludgeon. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.
This glaive excels at weighty slash attacks that crash into foes, making it a powerful weapon even on horseback.

name: Vulgar Militia Saw
description: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.
obtain: 1% chance to be dropped by Vulgar Militia enemies that wield it.
lore: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss.
The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.

name: Golden Halberd
description: Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights.  Deals holy damage. A masterfully crafted weapon that lives up to its heft, but is difficult for one mere human strength to wield.
obtain: Received upon defeating the Tree Sentinel between the Stranded Graveyard and the Church of Elleh in Limgrave.
lore: Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Deals holy damage.
A masterfully crafted weapon that lives up to its heft, but is difficult for one of mere human strength to wield.

name: Glaive
description: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war. This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by Skeletal Executioners that wield it, such as the one near the  Sellia Backstreets grace in Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
lore: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war.
This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.

name: Loretta's War Sickle
description: Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold.
obtain: Received upon defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.
lore: Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.
Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold.

name: Guardian's Swordspear
description: Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.  Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by Erdtree Guardians found near Minor Erdtrees or on the roots leading to the  Erdtree Sanctuary in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
lore: Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.
Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.

name: Dragon Halberd
description: Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
obtain: Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier in the lower Siofra River region. It is reached either by going through a Sending Gate found on top of a crumbled pillar on the eastern side of lower Siofra, just south of the  Worshippers' Woods grace. Alternatively, it may be reached by going all the way across the bridge from the Mimic Tear grace in Nokron, Eternal City and carefully dropping down the ledges on the building.
lore: Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning.
Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

name: Vulgar Militia Shotel
description: A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. The vulgar militia are the undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by Vulgar Militia and Shadow Militia enemies that wield it.
lore: A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.
The vulgar militia are undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world.

name: Gargoyle's Halberd
description: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyle Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
obtain: Received upon defeating the Valiant Gargoyle near the  West Capital Rampart grace, located in Leyndell.
lore: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.
Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax, a patchwork of champions.

name: Mace
description: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Strinking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances, Most suited to head on slugging matches.
obtain: Can be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for 800 runes.
lore: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions.
Striking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances. Most suited to head on slugging matches.

name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd
description: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
obtain: Dropped upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred guarding the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid.
lore: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.
Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

name: Curved Club
description: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.
obtain: 2% chance to drop from Second-Generation Albinaurics enemies that wield it.
lore: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon.
Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.

name: Warpick
description: Warhammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence. A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.
obtain: 2% chance to drop from Godrick Soldiers that wield it, such as those in Stormhill near the Castleward Tunnel or Mt. Gelmir near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite.
lore: Great hammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence.
A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.

name: Club
description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.
obtain:
Starting gear for the Wretch origin.
Possible loot from Club-wielding Demi-Humans with a 2% drop rate.
Bought for 600 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.
lore: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill.
A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.

name: Spiked Club
description: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.
obtain: 2% chance to drop from Mighty Demi-Human enemies that wield it.
lore: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss.
Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.

name: Hammer
description: Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool.  The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants. This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.
obtain:
Location: Leyndell, Royal Capital
The Hammer is found on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor, right next to the Sanctified Whetblade.
lore: Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool.
The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants. This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.

name: Varré's Bouquet
description: A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood.  This weapon reflects White Mask Varré's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.
obtain:
Mohgwyn Palace (Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance)
Drop: Defeat White Mask Varré at the end of his questline.
lore: A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood.
This weapon reflects White Mask Varré's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.

name: Morning Star
description: Warhammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star covered. in spikes which cause blood loss. Ironic given its grace name, this weapon often reeks of blood.
obtain: Found in a chest in a broken down carriage down the road to the south of Bridge of Sacrifice and Irina in the Weeping Peninsula region.
lore: Warhammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star is covered in spikes which cause blood loss.
Ironic given its graceful name, this weapon often reeks of blood.

name: Monk's Flamemace
description: Warhammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.  The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.
obtain: 4% chance to drop from various Fire Monk enemies wielding this weapon.
lore: Great hammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.
The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.

name: Envoy's Horn
description: Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by the smaller Oracle Envoy enemies that wield it.
lore: Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.
Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.
Unique Skill: Oracular Bubble
Blow on the horn to release a magic bubble. The bubble floats gently through the air towards its target.

name: Scepter Of The All-knowing
description: Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. The pearl stands for the world, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms of knowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All- Knowing's hand grasps for it.
obtain: Dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing within the  Erdtree Sanctuary in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
lore: Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.
The pearl stands for the world, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms of knowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All-Knowing's hand grasps for it.
Unique Skill: Knowledge Above All
Raise the scepter to manifest the realm of the All-Knowing. Enemy magic and holy damage negation will be reduced for all within the area, including the caster.

name: Nox Flowing Hammer
description: Mace shaped like a suspended metal droplet wielded by monks of the Eternal City. Forged from liquid metal from a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.
obtain: Found on a corpse in Night's Sacred Ground, located in Nokron, Eternal City. It is found on a stone arch in the same building as the Black Whetblade and the Mimic Tear Ashes.
lore: Mace shaped like a suspended metal droplet wielded by monks of the Eternal City.
Forged from liquid metal from a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.
Unique Skill: Flowing Form
Temporarily transforms armament into its liquid form. Swing the armament like a whip to strike surroundings before slamming its teardrop-shaped head down.

name: Ringed Finger
description: Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper. Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.
obtain:
Location: Gelmir Hero's Grave
The Ringed Finger is found in a chest inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave, located on Mt. Gelmir. The chest is at the very bottom of the first lava-filled ramp in the grave, in an alcove to the left.
lore: Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper.
Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.
Unique Skill: Claw Flick
Cause the finger to swell, then flex to build up strength before giving enemies an almighty flick.
Note: translated to English
A hammer made from cutting off Judge Rykard's finger.
Even after death, with Rykard's powerful magic, even a single finger is a powerful weapon.
loreNotes: In Chinese , the Ringed Finger was reportedly severed from Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.
This item may have been scrapped as a reward for turning in Remembrance of the Blasphemous earlier in development, as it remains visually identical to his ringed fingers.

name: Stone Club
description: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone.  This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.
obtain: 4% chance to drop from Battlemage enemies that wield it.
lore: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone. This club is much heavier than its size suggest, but has no magic power.
So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.

name: Marika's Hammer
description: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.
obtain:
Trade the Elden Remembrance, dropped by Elden Beast, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method.
lore: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it.
The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.
Unique Skill: Gold Breaker
Leap up high and, while suspended in midair, imbue the rune shard with light before smashing it down hard onto the ground. The heroic Radagon's signature attack.
loreNotes: There are two cut variants of this weapon: Father Marika's Hammer and Occult Marika's Hammer, each with a unique item description.<!--

name: Bloody Helice
description: Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. Designed to bore into flesh, causing severe blood loss at the wound. The extracted blood trickles gracefully down the length of the blade.
obtain: Writheblood Ruins, north of the Second Church of Marika in the Altus Plateau. It will be in a chest behind the Sanguine Noble miniboss.
lore: Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood.
Designed to bore into flesh, causing severe blood loss at the wound. The extracted blood trickles gracefully down the length of the blade.
Unique Skill: Dynast's Finesse
Nimbly avoid an attack, securing some distance from foes. Follow up with a strong attack to perform a sudden lunge, and press strong attack again to perform a sweeping slice.

name: Great Épée
description: Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade.  Commonly used in life or death duels. Like its smaller counterparts, its made for thrusting attacks, and can be used while guarding with a shield.
obtain: Found inside a chest east of the Agheel Lake South grace located in Limgrave.
lore: Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade. Commonly used in life or death duels.
Like its smaller counterparts, it is made for thrusting attacks, and can be used while guarding with a shield.

name: Godskin Stitcher
description: Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles. The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.
obtain:
Location: Temple of Eiglay
Received upon defeating the Godskin Noble boss guarding the Serpent's Amnion in the Temple of Eiglay, located at in Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.
lore: Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles.
The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.

name: Dragon King's Cragblade
description: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Dragonlord, gained by defeating Dragonlord Placidusax, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
lore: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance.
This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.
Unique Skill: Thundercloud Form
Temporarily transform into a red thundercloud and fly through the air, then plunge down with a lightning-infused blade. Hold to increase the reach of the thundercloud form.
loreNotes: Patch 1.04 decreased the skill's cost from 35 FP to 28 FP, decreased its recovery time, and decreased the damage of the uncharged version of the skill. Also increased skill cast speed.
Patch 1.07 increased the directional control of the skill.
Patch 1.08 reduced the speed of crouching light attacks and the stagger of two-handed jumping heavy attacks, and also the poise damage of all attacks in PvP.

name: Uchigatana
description: A katana with a long single-edged curved blade.  A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds. The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and ts slash attacks cause blood loss.
obtain:
Starting weapon for Samurai origin.
In the Deathtouched Catacombs.
lore: A katana with a long single-edged curved blade. A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds.
The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and its slash attacks cause blood loss.

name: Nagakiba
description: Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers. Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing lenth can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.
obtain: Received with the Piercing Fang Ash of War and Standard affinity on it. Either dropped by Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at the end of his questline at the Second Church of Marika or after being killed by the player. Otherwise, found at the last spot he was encountered before meeting Shabriri on the Mountaintops of the Giants.
lore: Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers.
Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing length can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.

name: Hand Of Malenia
description: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot. Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, gained by defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
lore: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot.
Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.
Unique Skill: Waterfowl Dance
Perform a series of one-footed leaps in the manner of a waterfowl to unleash a swift yet graceful slashing combo. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
loreNotes: Waterfowl Dance can be used to reach unintended locations.

name: Meteoric Ore Blade
description: Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. Deals magic damage. The blade is weighty, known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.
obtain: Found in the underground chambers in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins. It is inside of a chest behind a door in the far corner of the room.
lore: Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. Deals magic damage.
The blade is weighty, known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.
loreNotes: The unique overhead heavy attack is the same as the "Ichimonji" skill from FromSoftware's previous game, Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice.
Patch 1.07 increased the poise when using the skill.
Patch 1.08 reduced the poise damage for Katanas in PvP.
Patch 1.09 changed this weapon's scaling values.

name: Rivers Of Blood
description: Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men.  When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.
obtain: Defeat Okina at the Church of Repose.
lore: Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men.
When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.
Unique Skill: Corpse Piler
Forms a blade of cursed blood for repeated, interweaving successive attacks. Follow up with an additional input for further successive attacks.
loreNotes: The weapon's Japanese name, Shizanketsuga (屍山血河), is a four-character idiom referring to mounds of corpses and "rivers" of blood left in the aftermath of a battle.
Similarly, Rivers of Blood's Unique Skill is called Shishiruirui (死屍累々) in Japanese, another idiom that also refers to heaps of corpses left on a battlefield.

name: Moonveil
description: Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian wordsmith.  Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.
obtain: Defeat the Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel.
lore: Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian swordsmith.
Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.
Unique Skill: Transient Moonlight

Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with either a normal or a strong attack to draw the blade at great speed for an instant slash attack. Both attacks fire off a wave of light.

name: Dragonscale Blade
description: A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
obtain: Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss in the Lake of Rot.
lore: A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade.
Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
Unique Skill: Ice Lightning Sword
Call down a bolt of ice lightning into the blade and bring it down upon a foe. The ice lightning effect will persist for a while.

name: Serpentbone Blade
description: Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone. The denely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison
obtain: Obtained from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress after defeating Rileigh the Idle.
lore: Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone.
The densely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison.

name: Shortbow
description: Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.
obtain:
Starting weapon for the Bandit.
Purchased for  600 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.
2% chance to be dropped by Marionette Soldiers wielding them.
lore: A small bow for firing arrows from a distance. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback.
To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

name: Misbegotten Shortbow
description: Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it. Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.
obtain: 2% chance to drop from Winged Misbegotten enemies. A group of three can be found near the Ailing Village, along the cliffs just southeast of the  Ailing Village Outskirts Site of Grace.
lore: Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it.
Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.

name: Red Branch Shortbow
description: Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages.  A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.
obtain: 4% chance to drop from Pages.
lore: Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages.
A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.

name: Harp Bow
description: Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows. Troubadours sing tales of champions, both in the honorable service of the Erdtree, and the one who spurns honor for blasphemy.
obtain: Gained upon approaching the Painter Spirit on top of a cliff east of Sainted Hero's Grave, located in Altus Plateau. Requires having examined the "Champion's Song" Painting in the Shaded Castle.
lore: Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows.
Troubadours sing tales of champions, both in the honorable service of the Erdtree, and the one who spurns honor for blasphemy.

name: Composite Bow
description: Bow composited from a mix of Materials.  Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.
obtain: Sold by a Nomadic Merchant near the Bellum Church, located in Liurnia of the Lakes, for  3500 runes.
lore: Bow composited from a mix of materials.
Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.

name: Scythe
description: Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard.  In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.
obtain:
Location: Cliffbottom Catacombs
The  is found at the Cliffbottom Catacombs, located in the southeastern section of Liurnia of the Lakes. It is looted from a corpse guarded by four stone Imps on the upper level.
lore: Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard.
In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.

name: Grave Scythe
description: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between. This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped from the Skeleton Grave Keepers who carry it.
lore: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between.
This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.

name: Halo Scythe
description: War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by various scythe-wielding Cleanrot Knights.
lore: War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.
This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.
Unique Skill: Miquella's Ring of Light
Summon Miquella's shining halo and fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession.

name: Winged Scythe
description: Sacred scythe resembling a pair of white wings. Deals holy damage. According to pagan belief, white-winged maidens are said to be Death's gentle envoys.
obtain:
Location: Tombsward Ruins
The Winged Scythe is found in a treasure chest in the underground cellar at the Tombsward Ruins, located on the western Weeping Peninsula.
lore: Sacred scythe resembling a pair of white wings. Deals holy damage.
According to pagan belief, white-winged maidens are said to be Death's gentle envoys.
Unique Skill: Angel's Wings
Jump and imbue the wing-blade of the armament with light, then deliver a slashing attack on the enemy. The white wings impede recovery actions using a flask of tears.
loreNotes: The skill produces unique white feather visual effects.
This weapon is superficially similar to the shape of the Ancestral Followers' Greathorn Hammers, horns carved with tree ring-like markings.

name: Finger Seal
description: A sacred seal given by maidens of the Finger Readers which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations. Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.
obtain:
Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks for 800 Runes.
Obtained by default if selecting the Confessor or Prophet origins.
lore: A sacred seal bestowed by a Finger Maiden which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations.
Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.

name: Godslayer's Seal
description: Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian. Said to represent the manipulation of black flame, this catalyst enhances godslayer incantations.
obtain: Stormveil Castle: found inside a chest behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open. The cellar entrance can be found to the left of the courtyard if entered via the main gate and is guarded over by four rats.
lore: Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian.
Said to represent the manipulation of black flame, this catalyst enhances godslayer incantations.

name: Giant's Seal
description: Sacred seal depicting the one eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair. Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giants' Flame incantations.
obtain: Found near a Fire Prelate enemy inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Mountaintops of the Giants.
lore: Sacred seal depicting the one-eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair.
Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giant's Flame incantations.

name: Clawmark Seal
description: A sacred seal given by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength.  The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.
obtain: Received after feeding 1 Deathroot to Gurranq, Beast Clergyman inside the Bestial Sanctum located in Caelid.
lore: Sacred seal granted by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength.
The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.

name: Golden Order Seal
description: A formless sacred seal depicting the ceremonial observation of Order. Enhances Golden Fundamentalist incantations.  Fundamentalism is scholarship in all but name. Scales incantation using both intelligence and faith.
obtain: Found inside the Minor Erdtree Church, located between the two ramparts of Leyndell, Royal Capital.
lore: A formless sacred seal depicting the ceremonial observation of Order. Enhances Golden Order Fundamentalist incantations.
Fundamentalism is scholarship in all but name. Scales incantations using both intelligence and faith.

name: Erdtree Seal
description: A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between. Even though the Elden Ring is shattered, and the Erdtree has dulled from its former radiance, earnest faith continues to hold the answers.
obtain: Found inside a open cell down the town near the Prison Town Church grace, located in Volcano Manor. There is a Omenkiller enemy near it.
lore: A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between.
Even though the Elden Ring is shattered, and the Erdtree has dulled from its former radiance, earnest faith continues to hold the answers.
loreNotes: The Erdtree crest mentioned in the description is the one temporarily created on the ground or in the air when casting Erdtree Incantations.
This is the only Sacred Seal that also deals non-Physical damage when it's used to directly hit an enemy.

name: Dragon Communion Seal
description: Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations. The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power. Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate. This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.
obtain: Dropped by a spectral Banished Knight located in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave. To find it, start at the Stranded Graveyard Site of Grace and head down the first two ramps in the Grave, then head right in the split to go up another two ramps. The Knight is inside a small room at the end of the ramp and is quite tough for the early game. The Chariot in the dungeon can be used to help kill it, though that comes at considerable risk to the player as well.
lore: Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations.

The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power. Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate. This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.
loreNotes: Patch 1.04 decreased the scaling of status effect build-up from spells and incantations of Albinauric Staff and Dragon Communion Seal.

Previously both of these casting implements full Arcane-scaling would apply to the Status Effects build-up of spells cast with them. For a +10 Dragon Communion Seal, this meant that almost the full S (2.25) would be applied thus resulting in roughly 3 times the Status Effect build-up on builds with high Arcane which would often result in instant or near instant application of Madness with spells such as Frenzied Burst.

name: Frenzied Flame Seal
description: Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame. This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence, and faith all together.
obtain: Received upon completing Lightseeker Hyetta's questline.
lore: Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame.
This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence and faith all together.

name: Spear
description: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft. A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.
obtain:
2% chance to be dropped from the Exile Soldiers that wield it in Stormveil Castle.
A +7 version is dropped by Patches if he is killed, whether at his original spot in Murkwater Cave or at any point of his questline.
lore: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long shaft.
A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.

name: Short Spear
description: A exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.
obtain:
Starting equipment for the Prophet class.
Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks for 600 Runes.
4% chance to be dropped by Godrick Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers and Haligtree Foot Soldiers that wield it.
lore: An exceedingly plain spear of modest weight.
Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, its strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.

name: Crystal Spear
description: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.
obtain:
Location: Sellia Hideaway, Caelid
Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall in the large crystal-pierced room just before the tunnel leading to the boss room.
lore: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

name: Clayman's Harpoon
description: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains. The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by the slow-moving Claymen that wield it in the underground ruins of Siofra River and Ainsel River.
lore: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains.
The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

name: Partisan
description: Spear with a wide tip. In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swing to sweep through foes.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped from Knight enemies that wield it, such as the Godrick Knight in the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave, or the two Leyndell Knight near the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace in Mt. Gelmir.
lore: Spear with a wide tip.
In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swung to sweep through foes.

name: Celebrant's Rib-rake
description: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.
obtain:
Location: Altus Plateau
Celebrant's Rib-Rake has a 0.5% chance to drop from Dominula Dancers that wield it in Dominula, Windmill Village or East Windmill Pasture.
lore: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.
Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

name: Cleanrot Spear
description: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Melania, Blade of Miquella. The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shieldd is blessed with an incnantation that wards off rot.
obtain: 1% chance to be dropped by various spear-wielding Cleanrot Knights found for example in the Swamp of Aeonia and Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
lore: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.
The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shield is blessed with an incantation that wards off rot.
Unique Skill: Sacred Phalanx
Release the power of a hidden incantation to erect a palisade of golden spears frontwards.

name: Pike
description: A longspear featuring an especially length handle. Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incrdibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.
obtain: Found on a corpse inside Stormveil Castle, in the centre of the courtyard filled with Exile Soldiers operating Flamespitters.
lore: A longspear featuring an especially lengthy handle.
Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incredibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.

name: Torchpole
description: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead. Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by the Exile Soldiers that wield it in Stormveil Castle.
lore: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead.
Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.

name: Bolt Of Gransax
description: Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax. One of the legendary armaments.  A great ancient dragon, Gransax once rained calamity upon the Royal Capital - the only time in historical record that Leyendell's walls have fallen. This marked the dawn of the war against dragons.
obtain:
Located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
Exit the Erdtree Sanctuary and descend with the elevator, then jump over the street railing and down onto the building below. The spear is on top of its gigantic version.
Warning: This item is not present in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. It must be obtained prior to defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
lore: Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax. One of the legendary armaments.

A great ancient dragon, Gransax once rained calamity upon the Royal Capital - the only time in historical record that Leyndell's walls have fallen. This marked the dawn of the war against the ancient dragons.
Unique Skill: Ancient Lightning Spear
Imbue the armament with the ancient dragons' red lightning, then throw it as a spear. Can be charged to increase its power.

name: Cross-naginata
description: Weapon consisting of a three-pronged blade affixed to a long pole. The long central blade closely resembles a katana. A weapon of the Land of Reeds, known for its ability to be wielded as a spear while still being capable of performing slashing attacks.
obtain: Looted from a corpse in the Gael Tunnel. After leaving the Site of Grace, turn right into a side-passage leading to a large cavern guarded by a Land Octopus. The item is on the chamber's far end.
lore: Weapon consisting of a three-pronged blade affixed to a long pole. The long central blade closely resembles a katana.
A weapon of the Land of Reeds, known for its ability to be wielded as a spear while still being capable of performing slashing attacks.

name: Death Ritual Spear
description: Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds. The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.
obtain:
Location: Mountaintops of the Giants
The  is dropped by the Death Rite Bird on the Mountaintops of the Giants, located on the cliffs just southwest of Castle Sol. It appears even during the day. The nearby Tibia Mariner drops Helphen's Steeple.
lore: Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds.
The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.
Unique Skill: Spearcall Ritual
Thrust the spear high, bearing prayers into the sky to summon a downpour of spectral spears.
loreNotes: Reference to the Seven-Branched Sword dating to the Yamato period.
Patch 1.04 decreased the recovery time after using the skill.
Patch 1.07 increased the damage of the skill and decreased the amount of time the damage is active.
Patch 1.08 decreased poise damage of attacks in PvP.

name: Inquisitor's Girandole
description: Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the  Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir. Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds with flame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. A candlestick conveived by a thorough mind.
obtain: Received upon defeating the Abductor Virgin duo boss at the end of the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber of Volcano Manor.
lore: Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir.
Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds with flame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. A candlestick conceived by a thorough mind.

name: Spiked Spear
description: Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capaable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss. Weapon of the Marionette Soliders employed by sorcerers.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by spear-wielding Marionette Soldiers.
lore: Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss.
Weapon of the Marionette Soldiers employed by sorcerers.

name: Rotten Crystal Spear
description: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. Though festering with scarlet rot, its magic remains potent.
obtain: 8% chance to be dropped by the Putrid Crystalians who wield it in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
lore: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.
Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

name: Iron Spear
description: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by the spear-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers found through the upper plaza of Nokron, Eternal City and the Siofra Aqueduct.
lore: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.

name: Winged Spear
description: A spear with winged ornamentation at the base of its head. A thrusting weapon with long reach that can be used to attack from behind a shield. It is also effective against mounted foes.
obtain:
2% chance to be dropped from the Exile Soldiers that wield it in Stormveil Castle.
A +7 version is dropped by Patches if he is killed, whether at his original spot in Murkwater Cave or at any point of his questline.
lore: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long shaft.
A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.

name: Longsword
description: A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its easily-inflicted standard damage, this well- balanced weapon can also perform powerful piercing attacks.
obtain:
Starting armament of the Vagabond origin.
Purchased from Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.
lore: A straight sword with a double-edged blade.
In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks. A superbly balanced armament.

name: Short Sword
description: A short straight sword with a short blade.  In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.  Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.
obtain:
Starting equipment for the Astrologer class.
Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge for 600 Runes (x1).
4% drop chance off short sword-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, Haligtree Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers).
Murkwater Cave has many Highwaymen in a small area, making it a decent farming spot.
lore: A short straight sword with a short blade. In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.
Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.

name: Broadsword
description: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.
obtain:
Starting equipment for the Confessor class.
Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.
lore: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks.
Horizontal swing boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.

name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword
description: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a servicable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.
obtain:
Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have 2% drop rate for it.
This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, and Haligtree Soldiers.
Can be farmed from the very beginning of the game, at Gatefront Ruins, where some Godrick Soldiers wield this sword.
A more reliable spot can be found at Fourth Church of Marika, where two sword-wielding Mausoleum Soldiers can be found just outside the entrance.
lore: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army.
Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

name: Weathered Straight Sword
description: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people. Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.
obtain:
Dropped by Commoner enemies with a 4% drop rate.
An easy spot to farm is the room with a Grafted Scion, where 3 Commoners are sitting next to a fireplace near the stairs to the second floor (an easy path there is taking the elevator next to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace).
A more complicated but also more efficient farming spot is heading southwest from the Secluded Chamber Site of Grace and, once up a small pile of rocks, turn around to the right and use a wooden platform to jump to a thin stone ledge.
