lore: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people.
Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.
loreNotes: This weapon is equivalent to the Broken Straight Sword from Dark Souls, that being a very weak straight sword that's wielded by the most basic of undead enemies.

name: Golden Epitaph
description: A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die. Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death."
obtain: Found at the entrance of Auriza Hero's Grave. Requires a Stonesword Key to access and is guarded by a Basilisk.
lore: A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die.
Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death."
Unique Skill: Last Rites
Raise the epitaph to grant the effect of Sacred Order to yourself and allies in the vicinity. Particularly effective at laying to rest Those Who Live in Death.
loreNotes: An epitaph is "a short piece of writing or a poem about a dead person, especially one written on their gravestone" ([https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/epitaph Cambridge Dictionary]), which in this case would be the phrase "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death." in the description.
This weapons resembles the [https://demonssouls.fandom.com/wiki/Rune_Sword Rune Sword] from Demon's Souls.
Patch 1.12 fixed a bug that caused damage to the player and friendly summons when using the "Last Rites" Skill under specific circumstances.
Prior to the fix, Last Rites would be applied to non-damaging, persistent effects such as Terra Magica, making them deal the flat 25 Holy damage to any friendly players standing on it.

name: Ornamental Straight Sword
description: Slender straight sword patterned after an antique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand. After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.
obtain: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, either by beating it first try when starting the game or when visiting again through The Four Belfries in west Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Slender straight sword patterned after an unique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand.
After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.
Unique Skill: Golden Tempering
Cross the two swords to grant their attacks holy essence. While in effect, strong attack performs a dual-wielding combo attack.
loreNotes: The golden symbol displayed upon using the skill is the seal of the Erdtree, also displayed when casting Erdtree-associated incantations such as Erdtree Heal and Aspects of the Crucible: Horns.

Patch 1.07 added a timing for interrupting the attack during a series of strong attacks while under the effect, increased strong attack motion speed, poise damage, and stamina attack power against guarding enemies during the effect, increased the duration and attack power of the effect that grants the weapon a holy attribute, reduced time between the skill activation and being able to perform actions.

Increased the duration of the skill's weapon buff from 40 seconds to 60 seconds, and increased the amount of added Holy damage from 85 to 100. It also decreased the aftercast time where you are unable to do anything after performing the skill.
Patch 1.04 decreased FP cost and increased cast speed, and increased effect duration.

name: Coded Sword
description: Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel. Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.
obtain: The Coded Sword can be found on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital, in the room that mirrors the one that the Two Fingers of the Roundtable Hold can be found it. This weapon cannot be acquired once the Tarnished has defeated Maliketh.
lore: Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel.
Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.
Unique Skill: Unblockable Blade
Imbue the cipher blade with light, extending its length, then strike with a sudden sweeping attack. This attack cannot be blocked.
loreNotes: This weapon makes a unique, high-pitched swishing sound when swing. This trait is shared with the Cipher Pata, another cipher-like weapon associated with the Two Fingers.
Patch 1.07 reduced FP consumption, increased motion speed.
Applies to the skill. FP cost was reduced from 25 to 18.
Patch 1.04 increased cast speed with the weapon Coded Sword.

name: Sword Of Night And Flame
description: Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor. One of the legendary armaments. Astrologers, who preceded the sroveres, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.
obtain:
In a locked room at Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes, which the Tarnished can jump into from above on the walkways where the Raya Lucaria Soldier puppets appear.
More specifically, starting from the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace walk out onto the stone walkways and take a left when they path splits in two. Follow the path as it turn to the right and look to the left when halfway across the last walkway. Search for a nearby roof to jump onto and then walk forward to find another roof further down. In one of the corners should be a ladder leading down into the inside of a tower with a chest c
lore: Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor. One of the legendary armaments.
Astrologers, who preceded the sorcerers, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.
Unique Skill: Night-and-Flame Stance
Hold the sword level and prepare to cast a sorcery. Follow up with a normal attack to cast the Night Comet sorcery, or a strong attack to sweep forward with a burst of flames.
loreNotes: Despite the skill's description that the light attack follow-up casts Night Comet it actually casts Comet Azur.
Patch 1.07 increased attack power, the attack direction may now be adjusted up and down when using a normal attack, added damage detection to the weapon part.
This is in regard to the skill.
Increased the damage of the light attack follow-up from 100%, 150%, and 180% of weapon Magic Attack Power (1,180% in total) to 108%, 162%, and 194% of Magic Attack Power (1,274% in total).

name: Carian Knight's Sword
description: Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone.  Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty. These knights' swords could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.
obtain: Held by a Carriage located in the northwest region of Liurnia of the Lakes, between the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and The Four Belfries Sites of Grace.
lore: Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty.
These knights' sword could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.

name: Crystal Sword
description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.
obtain: Found after the bridge in the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose, to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

name: Sword Of St Trina
description: Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes. St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.
obtain: Behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in the Forsaken Ruins, Caelid, visible directly below the ledge at the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.
lore: Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes.
St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.
Unique Skill: Mists of Slumber
Releases a faint purple mist that spreads across a wide frontwards area. This mist inflicts the sleep ailment upon foes.
loreNotes: The inwards-curled and flowery hilt, resembling two Trina's Lily, gives it a striking resemblance to a sword that is generally considered to be the sword Tizón (alt. Tizona), owned by the legendary Spanish folk hero, knight, and ruler Rodrigo Días de Vivar aka El Cid.
Patch 1.06 fixed a bug where the effect added to the weapon upon using “Mists of Slumber” was lost when the player received an attack.
Patch 1.04 increased cast speed Of the skill.

name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
description: Sword forged by servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian knights. Instead of glintstone however, amber from the Haligtree is embedded in the blade. A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight — an ill-starred sword with no master. Skill: Sacred Blade
obtain:
Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, near the  Prayer Room Site of Grace.
After exiting the Grace in it to continue forward there will be a parapet on the right that leads to a tower with a ladder on the other side. Climbing that ladder leads to the sword's location.
lore: Sword forged by the servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian Knights. Instead of glintstone however, amber of the Haligtree is embedded in the blade.
A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight - an ill-starred sword with no master.

name: Cane Sword
description: Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn.  Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.
obtain: Found next to the stairs just south of the  West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
lore: Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn.
Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.

name: Regalia Of Eochaid
description: Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone.  Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies
obtain: On a ledge at the beach bordering Caelid and Limgrave, to the east of the Third Church of Marika. It can be reached through the Gaol Cave or by using Torrent to perform some tricky jumps to ascend the cliff face onto its ledge.
lore: Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone.
Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies.
Unique Skill: Eochaid's Dancing Blade
Infuse the sword with energy, then fling it forwards in a corkscrew attack. The sword continuously deals damage while violently spinning. Charge the attack to increase reach and duration of the spin.
loreNotes: Patch 1.07 reduced the delay between the end of various actions (such as using items or attack animations) and being able to perform the skill.
Patch 1.04 increased travel distance, added a window to roll during the attack to cancel the animation.

name: Noble's Slender Sword
description: Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.
obtain:
Dropped by Wandering Nobles that wield it with a 0.5% drop rate.
These specific nobles are distinguished by wearing the Aristocrat Garb (Altered) and Aristocrat Boots.
Sword-and-torch-wielding nobles will not drop the sword.
The Carriage on the road that runs north from the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace has several of these Nobles in its caravan.
lore: Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.
Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.
loreNotes: Identical base damage and scaling values to the Warhawk's Talon if on a Keen, Fire, or Lightning affinity.

name: Warhawk's Talon
description: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of the Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use. The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.
obtain:
Dropped by Warhawks in Stormveil Castle with a 2% drop rate.
4 of these birds can be found on the walls outside of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.
lore: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use.
The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.
loreNotes: Identical base damage and scaling values to the Noble's Slender Sword if on a Keen, Fire, or Lightning affinity.

name: Rotten Crystal Sword
description: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.
obtain: In a treasure chest guarded by three Crystalians in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, behind some large tree roots right after the Ephael Inner Wall grace.
lore: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.
Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
description: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage. Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made of wood.
obtain:
Dropped by Lazuli Glintstone Sorcerers with a 2% drop rate.
One can be easily reached just outside of the room with the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, just before the Red Wolf of Radagon in Academy of Raya Lucaria.
lore: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by the scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage.
Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made out of wood.

name: Estoc
description: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.  For its large size, it can be wirleded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.
obtain:
The Prisoner origin starts with the Estoc.
Sold by the Nomadic Merchant in southern Liurnia of the Lakes.
Sold by Patches once the Tarnished progresses his quest.
lore: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.
For its large size, it can be wielded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.

name: Rapier
description: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.  As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrust area easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.
obtain: Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 runes.
lore: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.
As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrusts are easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.

name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword
description: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long- handled armament.
obtain: Cleanrot Knight have a chance (4%) to drop this item.
lore: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.
Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long-handled armament.

name: Rogier's Rapier
description: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.
obtain: Obtained from Sorcerer Rogier in Roundtable Hold after defeating Godrick the Grafted.
lore: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier.
High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.

name: Antspur Rapier
description: Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot.  Scarlet rot is an old legend, of which Maleigh Marais of the Shaded Castle was a private believer. And indeed, he eventually found his own personal goddess.
obtain:
Location: Shaded Castle (exterior)
The  is obtained upon defeating Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan, a hostile NPC outside the Shaded Castle.
lore: Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot.
Scarlet rot is an old legend, of which Maleigh Marais of the Shaded Castle was a private believer. And indeed, he eventually found his own personal goddess.

name: Frozen Needle
description: A razor-thin piercing blade of ice. Forged by Ijii, the carian Royal Blackmith. Can inflict frost upon enemies, and launch its blade with a strong attack.  The blade immediately regenerates.
obtain: Found inside a chest after beating the Royal Revenant boss inside the Kingsrealm Ruins located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: A razor-thin piercing blade of ice. Forged by Iji, the Carian Royal Blacksmith.
Can inflict frost upon enemies, and launch its blade with a strong attack. The blade immediately regenerates.

name: Torch
description: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.
obtain: Bought from Merchant Kalé for  200 runes.
lore: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies.
Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminated more of the surrounding area.
Skill: Torch Attack
Thrust your torch forward to set foes ablaze. This Skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.

name: Noble's Estoc
description: Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.  Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.
obtain: Chance (0,5%) to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wield it, specifically the ones wearing the Aristocrat Hat and Aristocrat Coat. There are two immediately to the north of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace, following a torch bearer.
lore: Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.
Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

name: Steel-wire Torch
description: Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies. Heavier than a normal torch, but the heated filament boosts fire damage dealt.
obtain: Found at Castle Morne along the northern side of the castle, top level. It's on a body at the end of a narrow path, guarded by two misbegotten.
lore: Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies.
Heavier than a normal torch, but the heated filament boosts fire damage dealt.
Skill: Firebreather
Blow into torch flame, spreading flames in a wide frontward arc. The flames on the ground will continue to burn for a short time.

name: St. Trina's Torch
description: Candlestand torch that burns with a light-purple flame. The carvings depict St. Trina, but in adult form, somewhat unnervingly.  The light-purple flame induces sleep.
obtain:
Location: Consecrated Snowfield
St. Trina's Torch is found inside a wandering Great Coffin caravan in the southeastern Consecrated Snowfield.
lore: Candlestand torch that burns with a light-purple flame. The carving depicts St. Trina, but in adult form, somewhat unnervingly.
The light-purple flame induces sleep.
Unique Skill: Fires of Slumber
Blow into the candlestick's flame, creating a stream of hazy purple fire to cover the ground ahead. The intoxicating flames inflict the sleep ailment upon foes.
loreNotes: The Chinese and Korean release of the game preserve a very different earlier draft of this item description, roughly translating to "Trina's Torch: A torch with an exquisitely designed candlestick. Seeking Death since ancient times, this sacred relic has been entrusted with the mission of crusading against Death. It can illuminate Death's darkness."

name: Ghostflame Torch
description: Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.
obtain:
Location: Nokron, Eternal City
The  is found on a corpse on the narrow rooftops near the entrance of Nokron, Eternal City.
lore: Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers.

When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.
Skill: Torch Attack
Thrust torch forward to set foes ablaze. This skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.

name: Beast-repellent Torch
description: A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts. Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.
obtain: Sold by the Isolated Merchant in northwest Dragonbarrow, located in northern Caelid.
lore: A torch which burns oil infused with special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts.
Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.
Skill: Torch Attack
Thrust torch forward to set foes ablaze. This skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.

name: Sentry's Torch
description: Torch Given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.
obtain: Bought from the Hermit Merchant for 7000 runes in Altus Plateau near the first rampart of the capital.
lore: Torch given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils.
Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.
Skill: Torch Attack
Thrust torch forward to set foes ablaze. This skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.

name: Godskin Peeler
description: Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh. Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.
obtain: Defeat the Godskin Apostle at Dominula, Windmill Village in the northern Altus Plateau.
lore: Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh.
Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.

name: Twinned Knight Swords
description: An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way.  Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.
obtain: Found on a corpse near the East Windmill Pasture located in Altus Plateau.
lore: An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way.
Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

name: Eleonora's Poleblade
description: Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.
obtain: Defeating Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika in the Altus Plateau.
lore: Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger.
Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.
Unique Skill: Bloodblade Dance
Leap at foe to perform a flurry of tornado-like attacks. Follow up with an additional input to perform an attack that ends in an evasive maneuver.

name: Gargoyle's Twinblade
description: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyle.  just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
obtain: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss, locating at the Siofra Aqueduct.
lore: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.
Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
description: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyle, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
obtain: Received upon defeating Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold.
lore: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.
Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

name: Large Club
description: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength to swing about.
obtain: Found on a corpse on a cliff near a group of Demi-Human enemies in a forested area south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, located in Limgrave.
lore: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill.
A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength to swing about.

name: Greathorn Hammer
description: Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors. The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by various Ancestral Follower Warriors who wield it.
lore: Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors.
The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

name: Battle Hammer
description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.
obtain:
4% chance to be dropped by Grave Warden Duelists outside the Royal Colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
The Duelists cannot be found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. The hammer can therefore not be acquired after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
lore: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

name: Great Mace
description: Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin. Maintains all the advantages of smaller bludgeons, boasting few deficiencies while being very capable at breaking enemy guards and stances. A shrewd choice for simple slugging matches.
obtain: Found inside a chest around the trebuchets before the Grand Lift of Dectus in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin.
Maintains all the advantages of smaller bludgeons, boasting few deficiencies while being very capable at breaking enemy guards and stances. A shrewd choice for simple slugging matches.

name: Curved Great Club
description: Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.
obtain: 4% chance to drop from large Albinauric enemies that wield it in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Large curved club of hard wood shaped like a crescent moon.
Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.

name: Celebrant's Skull
description: Large bludgeon ecorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics.  Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.   The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.
obtain:
Location: Altus Plateau
Looted from a corpse on a cliff ledge to the northeast of the Windmill Village Site of Grace within Dominula, Windmill Village.
lore: Large bludgeon decorated with flowers and many-decorated fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.
The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human. Grants trace amount of runes on landing attacks.

name: Beastclaw Greathammer
description: Greathammer with a striking end modelled to resemble five beastly claws. The black nails protruding from golden fur are said to represent Serosh, Lord of Beasts, who went to become King Godfrey's Regent.
obtain: Awarded by Gurranq, Beast Clergyman for feeding him 7 Deathroot.
lore: Great hammer with a striking end modelled to resemble five beastly claws.
The black nails protruding from golden fur are said to represent Serosh, Lord of Beasts, who went on to become King Godfrey's Regent.
Unique Skill: Regal Beastclaw
Slam the hammer into the ground, rending the land asunder with the armament's five bestial claws.

name: Twinblade
description: A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield, and requires high dexterity. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is enabled  with dual-handed spinning attacks.
obtain: Found inside one of the two chests at the Dragon-Burnt Ruins located in Limgrave. It will be in the basement room without the Rats, reached by jumping over a crumbled wall into an enclosure.
lore: A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield and demands high dexterity.
Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

name: Envoy's Long Horn
description: Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by large Oracle Envoys.
lore: Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.
Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps is it too early to sound the call.
Unique Skill: Bubble Shower
Blow on the horn to release a spume of magic bubbles. The bubbles float gently before raining down the target.

name: Pickaxe
description: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by miners who wield it.
lore: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners.
Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"

name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
description: Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed Monk Prelate of the Giants' Flame. Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it be used as a  candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.
obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, behind the second imp statue in the dungeon.
lore: Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed Monk Prelate of the Giants' Flame.

Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it to be used as a candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.
Unique Skill: Surge of Faith

Set the flames of Birac's faith ablaze in the cranial vessel, then raise it aloft to rain down fireballs in all directions. Repeated inputs will continue to raise the armament aloft, continuing the attack.

name: Great Stars
description: Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss. A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restores HP.
obtain: Found inside a carriage pulled by Trolls on a route between the  Road of Iniquity Side Path grace and the Writheblood Ruins located in Altus Plateau.
lore: Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss.
A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restores HP.

name: Devourer's Scepter
description: Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of  Blasphemy. One of the legendary armaments. A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final moments before being devoured by the great serpent.
obtain: Received upon killing Knight Bernahl in Crumbling Farum Azula.
lore: Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of Blasphemy. One of the legendary armaments.
A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final moments before being devoured by the great serpent.
Unique Skill: Devourer of Worlds
Charge the scepter with magic and strike it against the ground to steal the HP of all nearby enemies.

name: Brick Hammer
description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.
obtain:
Location: Stormveil Castle
The  is found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle in the area within the wall past the  Stormveil Cliffside site of grace. It is accessed by climbing the ladder behind the door unlocked by the Rusty Key and turning right to jump across the gap, crossing the beams, and then jumping to another platform leading to an opening in the wall. Follow the path outside and reenter at the round tower. The corpse hangs from a ledge.
lore: Weapon made from an ordinary stone brick. Wielded by a laborer who lead a rebellion, and later become a champion himself.
Even among other bludgeons of its size, this weapon is especially weighty. The strength of a giant is required to wield it.

name: Whip
description: A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain. Through its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.
obtain: Castle Morne: Inside the second prison cell area reached by dropping down onto a couple of beams. The room is filled with rats and a misbegotten.
lore: A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain.
Through its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.

name: Rotten Battle Hammer
description: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike. Skill: Braggart's Roar Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.
obtain: Dropped by a Putrid Grave Warden Duelist located west of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.
lore: Large iron warhammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot.
Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

name: Thorned Whip
description: Hefty whip coverd in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of fin.  Very effective at inflicting blood loss.
obtain: The  has a 4.00% chance to drop from Fire Prelates that wield it.
lore: Hefty whip covered in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of sin.
Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

name: Magma Whip Candlestick
description: This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir. When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.
obtain: Reward from Patches in Volcano Manor after defeating Great Horned Tragoth. Won't be given the first time he is spoken too. Instead, the area has to be reloaded in some way (either via teleporting or by exiting and re-entering the game) and he can be spoken to again to gain the weapon.
lore: This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir.
When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.
Unique Skill: Sea of Magma
Swing a molten whip overhead to temporarily cover the surrounding area in a sea of magma. Hold to continue swinging the lava whip.

name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
description: Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down though the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow. High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastation
obtain: Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood after invading him at the Shack of the Lofty on the Mountaintops of the Giants. The invasion sign appears after receiving the Red Letter, the final contract from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress.
lore: Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down through the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow.
High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastating blood loss. "The tale of House Hoslow is told in blood."

name: Giant's Red Braid
description: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Fire Giant, gained by defeating Fire Giant, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
lore: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant.
Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.
Unique Skill: Flame Dance
Imbue the red braid with the Giants' Flame and lash out in a wide range with a series of agile swings.

name: Urumi
description: This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfold warriors. Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.
obtain: Found on a corpse up on the rooftops of Caria Manor, located in northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfolk warriors.
Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.

name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword
description: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. Greatsword of ancient meteoric ore, ending in a sharp point. Fashioned from an excavated shard of an arrowhead that once was a part of the old gods' arsenal. A capable piercing weapon that excels at thrusting attacks. Unique Skill: White Light Charge Summons white light from the crevice in the weapon's ancient meteoric ore, using its power for a charging attack which pierces foes. Additional input causes the light to explode.
obtain:
Location: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
The Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword is obtained upon examining the forge altar at the Ruined Forge Starfall Past.
The altar is found on the second level. To reach the altar, you must pull the lever to make the iron door rise, and use it as a platform to jump across to the second level where the altar is.
lore: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. Greatsword of ancient meteoric ore, ending in a sharp point.
Fashioned from an excavated shard of an arrowhead that once was a part of the old gods' arsenal. A capable piercing weapon that excels at thrusting attacks.
Unique Skill: White Light Charge
Summons white light from the crevice in the weapon's ancient meteoric ore, using its power for a charging attack which pierces foes. Additional input causes the light to explode.
loreNotes: Likely inspired by thunderstones, wherein Neolithic stone tools were mistaken for the weapons of the gods by later discoverers, unaware of human prehistory.

name: Anvil Hammer
obtain: This weapon can be found and obtained at the altar at the end of the Ruined Forge Lava Intake.
lore: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. A tremendous hammer that incorporates as its head the red-hot anvil of the forge.
It is said that the anvil's shape is inspired by that of an altar, and that long ago, it was indeed used as such in rite and ritual.
Unique Skill: Smithing Art Spears
Slam the red-hot anvil into the ground, sending up countless spears as it is pulled out. The spears disappear instantly.

name: Backhand Blade
description: Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip. A type of weapon wielded by hornsent for generations. Wielding this weapon resembles a deadly dance.
obtain: This weapon can be found beside a coffin, in the Inquisitor enemies' area of Gravesite Plain, northeast from the  Scorched Ruins site of grace.
lore:
Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip.
A type of weapon wielded by hornsent for generations.
Wielding this weapon resembles a deadly dance.

name: Beast Claw (weapon)
description: Weapon in the form of a carnivorous beast's vicious claws. Used to perform bestial slashing attacks uncanny to humankind. An imitation of the esoteric technique of the horned warriors. Those who carry this weapon wield it as though they have been possessed by a savage beast.
obtain: This weapon is dropped from Logur, the Beast Claw, in the southern area of Gravesite Plains, on the way to the Church of Consolation from the Gravesite Plain site of grace.
lore: Weapon in the form of a carnivorous beast's vicious claws. Used to perform bestial slashing attacks uncanny to humankind.
An imitation of the esoteric technique of the horned warriors. Those who carry this weapon wield it as though they have been possessed by a savage beast.

name: Black Steel Greathammer
description: Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Greathammer of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power. Guard Counters cause a burst of power.
obtain: Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight found in the Church of Consolation at the end of the downhill path east of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace.
lore: Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Greathammer of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold.
Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power. Guard Counters cause a burst of power.

name: Black Steel Twinblade
description: Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Twinblade of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.
obtain: Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the top of the western hill camp off to the side of the encampment in front of the Shadow Keep in Scadu Altus.
lore: Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Twinblade of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold.
Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

name: Bloodfiend's Fork
description: Weapon used by the bloodfiends. Three tines of carved bone spear the victim to provoke blood loss. A ritual implement for blood offerings to the Formless Mother. At times, the bloodfiends will spill even their own blood using these forks.
obtain: 3% chance to be dropped by various Bloodfiends who wield it.
lore: Weapon used by the bloodfiends. Three tines of carved bone spear the victim to provoke blood loss.
A ritual implement for blood offerings to the Formless Mother. At times, the bloodfiends will spill even their own blood using these forks.

name: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear
description: Greatspear of the bloodfiend hexers. One of the most significant implements used in their blood rituals. Sacred spears of blood are the instruments of communion with an outer god. The mother of truth desires a wound. Unique Skill: Bloodfiends' Bloodboon Raise the sacred spear and pierce the body of the mother of truth, creating an explosion of bloodflame in the area surrounding the target. Additional input allows for up to three follow-up attacks.
obtain: Guaranteed drop from a Bloodfiend Hexer in Rauh Base. It can be found in a shallow pond to the west of Taylew's Ruined Forge.
lore: Greatspear of the bloodfiend hexers. One of the most significant implements used in their blood rituals.
Sacred spears of blood are the instruments of communion with an outer god. The mother of truth desires a wound.
Unique Skill: Bloodfiends' Bloodboon
Raise the sacred spear and pierce the body of the mother of truth, creating an explosion of bloodflame in the area surrounding the target. Additional input allows for up to three follow-up attacks.

name: Bone Bow
description: A crude shortbow fashioned from sickly bone. A medium for spirit-calling, and a product of the ancient hexing arts of the tower. Unique Skill: Rancor Shot Imbue arrows with vengeful spirits, before firing off a barrage. Imbued arrows chase down foes as they cut through the air.
obtain:
Location: Belurat, Tower Settlement
The  is found on a corpse in the Upper Residential Ward of Belurat, Tower Settlement. From the  Belurat, Tower Settlement site of grace, turn left and ascend the elevator shortcut, then turn left again to enter the bottom of the spiral staircase tower. The bow is on the other side of the room, guarded by numerous Baby Spider Scorpions and two Large Spider Scorpions.
lore: A crude shortbow fashioned from sickly bone.
A medium for spirit-calling, and a product of the ancient hexing arts of the tower.
Unique Skill: Rancor Shot
Imbue arrows with vengeful spirits, before firing off a barrage. Imbued arrows chase down foes as they cut through the air.

name: Bonny Butchering Knife
description: Weapon of the greater potentates of Bonny Village. An outsize butcher's cleaver used to dismember human bodies in the making of the great jars stored in the gaols. Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy. Unique Skill: Hone Blade Perform a stroking action to sharpen blade, honing its cutting edge and increasing amount of HP recovered. The greater potentates treasure the tools of their practice.
obtain: The weapon can be found at Bonny Village below a small shed outside a house, near the broken bridge.
lore: Weapon of the greater potentates of Bonny Village. An outsize butcher's cleaver used to dismember human bodies in the making of the great jars stored in the gaols.
Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.
Unique Skill: Hone Blade
Perform a stroking action to sharpen blade, honing its cutting edge and increasing amount of HP recovered. The greater potentates treasure the tools of their practice.

name: Carian Sorcery Sword
description: One of the Carian royal family's glintstone swords. A small piercing sword with a slender blade. Formerly used by the Carian knights of old before the full refinement of their sorcerous combat techniques, this armament functions as a catalyst for glintstone sorcery when executing strong attacks.
obtain: This item can be found in a chest in Castle Ensis after dropping down from Scadu Altus.
effect: Becomes a catalyst for Glintstone Sorceries upon using Strong attacks
lore: One of the Carian royal family's glintstone swords. A small piercing sword with a slender blade.
Formerly used by the Carian knights of old before the full refinement of their sorcerous combat techniques, this armament functions as a catalyst for glintstone sorcery when executing strong attacks.

name: Chilling Perfume Bottle
description: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing an icy chill. From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens.
obtain: Found on a corpse inside the Lamenter's Gaol.
lore: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow.
Attacks release perfumed powder, producing an icy chill.
From time to time, perfumers set out on journeys to pursue new aromatics and flower gardens.

name: Claws of Night
description: Claws of a bottomless black from which no light can escape. Wielded by Anna, Swordhand of Night. Engraved with a smithscript enabling strong attack to launch all three claws at a target. The blades are only semicorporeal, and cannot be fully guarded against.
obtain: Dropped by Swordhand of Night Anna in the Finger Ruins of Miyr.
lore: Claws of a bottomless black from which no light can escape. Wielded by Anna, Swordhand of Night.
Engraved with a smithscript enabling strong attack to launch all three claws at a target. The blades are only semicorporeal, and cannot be fully guarded against.

name: Curseblade's Cirque
description: Weapon of the masked Curseblades. Circular backhand blade with wave-like cutting edges, sharpened into points that incite blood loss. Long ago, this was employed by the ascetics who strove to become tutelary deities as a ritualistic object in their self-flagellating dances. Unique Skill: Deadly Dance An aggressive spinning skill that tears into foes using the circular blades held in each hand. Additional input allows for a sharp axe-kick follow-up.
obtain: It has a 3% chance to be dropped when defeating a Curseblade anywhere in the Realm of Shadow, except for the one perched up on a beam inside the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, which has a 2% to drop this item instead.
lore: Weapon of the masked Curseblades. Circular backhand blade with wave-like cutting edges, sharpened into points that incite blood loss.
Long ago, this was employed by the ascetics who strove to become tutelary deities as a ritualistic object in their self-flagellating dances.
Unique Skill: Deadly Dance
An aggressive spinning skill that tears into foes using the circular blades held in each hand. Additional input allows for a sharp axe-kick follow-up.

name: Dancing Blade of Ranah
description: Decorative swords ablaze with impassioned red. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Used by the dancers of Ranah. Strike enemies with a dancing assault when executing a strong attack. Unique Skill: Unending Dance A furious dance formed by a succession of slashing attacks. Hold the button down to sustain the dance for as long as stamina allows.
obtain: Can be obtained when dropped by the Dancer of Ranah at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.
lore: Decorative swords ablaze with impassioned red. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands.
Used by the dancers of Ranah. Strike enemies with a dancing assault when executing a strong attack.
Unique Skill: Unending Dance
A furious dance formed by a succession of slashing attacks. Hold the button down to sustain the dance for as long as stamina allows.

name: Dane's Footwork
description: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art focuses on kicking techniques. This kick-based martial art is unique to Dane, a Dryleaf and sworn ally of Leda. He acquired these skills by training with the aid of a waterfall; letting the water beat his body, and throwing himself into its basin.
obtain: Looted from Dryleaf Dane's corpse after the battle in the Cleansing Chamber of Enir-Ilim. He lies next to the door forward.
lore: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art focuses on kicking techniques.

This kick-based martial art is unique to Dane, a Dryleaf and sworn ally of Leda. He acquired these skills by training with the aid of a waterfall; letting the water beat his body, and throwing himself into its basin.

name: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle
description: Perfume bottle customized by Thiollier. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing deadly poison. There are some techniques of the perfuming arts that employ poison. Upon learning of this, Thiollier threw himself into mastering those techniques, and he made them his own. Unique Skill: Deadly Poison Spray Swings the perfume bottle overhead, wafting perfumed powder of deadly poison over a wide area. Poison shall dance upon the air and pour down in quiet calm.
obtain: Purchased from Thiollier for  6,000 Runes.
lore: Perfume bottle customized by Thiollier.
Attacks release perfumed powder, producing deadly poison.
There are some techniques of the perfuming arts that employ poison. Upon learning of this, Thiollier threw himself into mastering those techniques, and he made them his own.
Unique Skill: Deadly Poison Spray
Swings the perfume bottle overhead, wafting perfumed powder of deadly poison over a wide area. Poison shall dance upon the air and pour down in quiet calm.

name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe
description: A long-hafted golden axe wielded by the Death Knight. Bears a representation of a decayed golden ring. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate. Unique Skill: Blinkbolt: Long-hafted Axe From a low stance, the body is transformed into a bolt of lightning and charges straight ahead at fulgurous speed. Strong attack performs a lightning-charged leaping slash.
obtain: This weapon is dropped after defeating the Death Knight of the Scorpion River Catacombs.
lore: A long-hafted golden axe wielded by the Death Knight. Bears a representation of a decayed golden ring. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.
Unique Skill: Blinkbolt: Long-hafted Axe
From a low stance, the body is transformed into a bolt of lightning and charges straight ahead at fulgurous speed. Strong attack performs a lightning-charged leaping slash.

name: Death Knight's Twin Axes
description: Golden war axes of the Death Knight. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate. Unique Skill: Blinkbolt: Twinaxe From a low stance, the body is transformed into a bolt of lightning and charges straight ahead at fulgurous speed. Strong attack performs a lightning-charged spinning slash.
obtain:
Location: Fog Rift Catacombs
Dropped by the Death Knight boss.
lore: Golden war axes of the Death Knight. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.
Unique Skill: Blinkbolt: Twinaxe
From a low stance, the body is transformed into a bolt of lightning and charges straight ahead at fulgurous speed. Strong attack performs a lightning-charged spinning slash.

name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana
description: Great katana with spines of gravel stone along its blade, wielded by the Ancient Dragon-Man of the Dragon's Pit. Has an anti-dragon effect. Formerly a Dragon Communion warrior, the Ancient Dragon-Man was once arbiter of those worthy to devour the Dreaded One. Unique Skill: Dragonwound Slash Designed to hunt colossal dragons, this skill cloaks the armament with a jagged gravel-stone aura before performing a high leaping slash. Charge the attack to also fire off the aura.
obtain:
Location: Dragon's Pit
The Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is obtained upon defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the bottom of the Dragon's Pit.
lore: Great katana with spines of gravel stone along its blade, wielded by the Ancient Dragon-Man of the Dragon's Pit. Has an anti-dragon effect.
Formerly a Dragon Communion warrior, the Ancient Dragon-Man was once arbiter of those worthy to devour the Dreaded One.
Unique Skill: Dragonwound Slash
Designed to hunt colossal dragons, this skill cloaks the armament with a jagged gravel-stone aura before performing a high leaping slash. Charge the attack to also fire off the aura.

name: Dryleaf Arts
description: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art combines fist strikes and kicks. The teachings of a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect, revealed only to those of worthy valor and character. The practice of this martial art marks the dawn of an ascetic's journey.
obtain: Dropped by Dryleaf Dane after the spar at Moorth Ruins.
lore: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art combines fist strikes and kicks.
The teachings of a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect, revealed only to those of worthy valor and character. The practice of this martial art marks the dawn of an ascetic's journey.

name: Dryleaf Seal
description: Sacred seal of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Enhances incantations of Miquella. Those who saw the decline of the Erdtree in the fallen leaves long ago braced themselves for the weakening of the Order, and embraced a strict faith. And then, they made to serve a new god.
obtain: Found on a corpse near the  Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace. Go north until you find a ledge with several Gravebirds. The seal lies on a ledge just below Dane's message.
lore: Sacred seal of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Enhances incantations of Miquella.
Those who saw the decline of the Erdtree in the fallen leaves long ago braced themselves for the weakening of the Order, and embraced a strict faith. And then, they made to serve a new god.

name: Euporia
description: Twinblade symbolizing abundance. The secret treasure of the tower. Though the blades, fashioned from golden shoots, are largely wilted and darkened, their luster can be restored by dealing damage to foes. However, damage dealt to Those Who Live in Death will have no such effect. Unique Skill: Euporia Vortex Using the power of the vortex, violently twirl the armament, dealing multiple slashes directly ahead. The greater the restored luster of the blades, the greater the power of this skill. However, use of this skill will fully consume the blades' luster.
obtain: This armament can be found in Belurat, Tower Settlement. However, reaching it can only be done through Enir-Ilim. On the stairs past the lightning-aspected Divine Beast Warrior, jump off the path onto a lower staircase and then follow the ledges down until you reach a platform with a Fireproof Pickled Liver. Jump into the nearby window (sprinting is advised), and then go out to the balcony and follow the path to the right down the lifts, past the Inquisitors and the Divine Beast Warrior. Euporia lies at the end of this path.
effect: Gains Luster upon damaging an enemy, which increases the potency of its Skill.
lore: Twinblade symbolizing abundance. The secret treasure of the tower.

Though the blades, fashioned from golden shoots, are largely wilted and darkened, their luster can be restored by dealing damage to foes. However, damage dealt to Those Who Live in Death will have no such effect.
Unique Skill: Euporia Vortex

Using the power of the vortex, violently twirl the armament, dealing multiple slashes directly ahead. The greater the restored luster of the blades, the greater the power of this skill. However, use of this skill will fully consume the blades' luster.

name: Falx
description: Curved swords with long sickle-like blades. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Forged by a hornsent in the name of revenge. "In vengeance for the flames, my blade I wield..." Unique Skill: Revenger's Blade Dash up to an enemy and slash them open with the blades held in each hand. By holding down the button, the initial slash will be extended. Follow up with strong attack to hack the enemy to pieces.
obtain: It can be obtained wherever Hornsent is killed, depending on your actions and choices.
lore: Curved swords with long sickle-like blades. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands.
Forged by a hornsent in the name of revenge. "In vengeance for the flames, my blade I wield..."
Unique Skill: Revenger's Blade
Dash up to an enemy and slash them open with the blades held in each hand. By holding down the button, the initial slash will be extended. Follow up with strong attack to hack the enemy to pieces.
loreNotes: Falx was a real-world weapon with a curved blade sharpened along the inner edge, used by the Thracians and Dacians in antiquity. The name derives from the Latin word falx, originally meaning "sickle", though it later came to refer to various tools with sickle-like blades.

name: Fire Knight's Greatsword
description: Greatsword of the Fire Knights. A long, slender blade that undulates like fire. Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.
obtain: Fire Knights wielding this weapon in the Shadow Keep have a 4.0% chance of dropping it upon being killed.
lore: Greatsword of the Fire Knights. A long, slender blade that undulates like fire.
Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

name: Fire Knight's Seal
description: Sacred seal of the Fire Knights, who answer directly to Messmer the Impaler. Enhances fire incantations of Messmer. The emblem of Messmer's army depicts a golden ring and the fire of his sacred seal.
obtain:
Location: Shadow Keep, Church District
The  is looted from a corpse in the Church District of the Shadow Keep behind the statue in the church's altar room. It becomes accessible after the water drains.
lore: Sacred seal of the Fire Knights, who answer directly to Messmer the Impaler.

Unique Skill: Flare, O Serpent
Ignites a flame inside the snakes, temporarily empowering flame attacks. Once ignited, strong attacks and other moves that strike the ground will cause an explosion.

name: Shadow Sunflower Blossom
description: The head of a monstrous shadow sunflower manifestation of the Scadutree. Then again, it might be just a flower, wielded as a weapon. Much like the Scadutree itself in appearance, a second stalk winds tightly around the first, almost as if in a tender embrace. Unique Skill: Shadow Sunflower Headbutt Slam down the blossom of a large shadow sunflower, sending out a shockwave that flattens foes. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
obtain: Can be obtained upon trading the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

obtain: This weapon can be found at Taylew's Ruined Forge. Follow the path until you reach a crumbled floor. Jump over the gap and turn left to enter a room with a Golem Smith. The axe is at the far end of the room.

description: Circular backhand blade engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack to throw the backhand blade, causing it to fly in a curved trajectory.
obtain: It can be looted from a body located by the edge of the sewage waterfall in Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

description: Dagger engraved with a smithscript. Reduced mass enhances the effects of the smithing arts, allowing this weapon to function as a throwing dagger for all attacks. Once thrown, the dagger instantly reappears in the wielder's hand.
obtain: Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Proceed normally through the dungeon until you reach the lever that moves the lava pipe and then drop down to the floor below. The dagger can be found behind the Golem Smith.

Location: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
On a corpse not far past the entrance. It is found to the right after crossing the bridge in the first room, near the ladder.

description: Weapon of Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact. Unique Skill: Messmer's Assault A fierce succession of attacks using a flame-coated spear tip. Repeated inputs allow up to two follow-up attacks. The final move thrusts the spear into the ground, causing countless spears to form in the surrounding area.

description: Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A glaive that has seen many years of use in the gravesite. Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits. Unique Skill: Rancor Slash Spin around, slashing foes while summoning vengeful spirits which chase down foes. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
obtain: In order to obtain this weapon, you first start at the site of grace at Charo's Hidden Grave and walk through the arch to the northwest, turn right directly after and take the path that ramps up north, follow it to where it meets the edge of the Gravesite Plain and it will be on a grave.

description: A modified crossbow made by combining two crossbows into one. Capable of loading multiple bolts and firing them simultaneously, enabling a spread of fire.

name: Staff of the Great Beyond
description: Staff fashioned from the tail-fingers of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, and the microcosm raised aloft over the crux they form. Catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations. The Mother received signs from the Greater Will from the beyond of the microcosm. Despite being broken and abandoned, she kept waiting for another message to come.

Trade the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers, dropped by Metyr, Mother of Fingers, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

description: A sword that none can pull from its scabbard of cracked stone. Relic of a lost civilization from a time long past, said to have served a ritual purpose at altars of light and darkness.

An additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

name: Sword of Night
description: Sword of an all-consuming, bottomless black that devours even the light that shines upon it. Wielded by Jolán, Swordhand of Night. The blade of the sword is only semicorporeal, and thus cannot be guarded against completely. Can be charged to increase its power.

name: Thiollier's Hidden Needle
description: Concealed weapon used by Thiollier, of a design generally favored by poison-wielders for dark and subtle purposes. Like St. Trina, who blossomed in the deep-purple garden, a rich poison is secreted from within which sends its victims into an eternal sleep. Unique Skill: Sleep Evermore Pierces the enemy deeply with a poison-coated needle that delivers eternal sleep. If the follow-up strike lands upong a foe who is already in a state of slumber or eternal sleep, it will deal significant damage.
obtain: Acquired from Thiollier after defeating Promised Consort Radahn at the top of Enir-Ilim, but only if you have completed his quest line before reaching Needle Knight Leda in the Cleansing Chamber.

Temporarily reduces the rate at which stamina recovers. Thus does the pain encourage obedience.
obtain: Found inside the Whipping Hut on the outskirts of Bonny Village, across a rope bridge.
